user_prompt_en:
I've been documenting my development workflows for my blog for a while now, and I finally decided to put together a dedicated landing page for this new CLI developer tool I've been working on. Since a huge chunk of my readership and the target audience for this tool are based overseas, the primary language will be English, and I really want the reading experience to feel seamless and engaging. I want it to read more like a well-crafted technical essay rather than a dry, corporate software manual. To help with this, I'd like a sticky, unobtrusive table of contents on the side so readers can easily jump between the introductory concepts and the deeper technical archives without losing their place. The page structure needs to be highly intuitive, guiding visitors smoothly down to the nitty-gritty implementation details. For the very top of the page, the hero section needs a strong, overarching statement that immediately grabs attention. I was looking through some tabs I have open for inspiration, and I really love how the text is handled on that page with the blue 'Start free' buttons at the top right. They use this massive, extremely heavy and tightly packed black sans-serif font for their main headings. It creates a striking, authoritative contrast against the clean background and smaller body text, and I want that exact handling of the text for my main hero title here.

Right below this introduction, I want to introduce the core capabilities of the tool using a dynamic tabbed interface. This is a critical functional piece because I need to show different code snippets, configuration files, and terminal outputs without forcing the user to scroll endlessly. The tabs should let people switch between 'Installation', 'Local Setup', and 'Deployment' views instantly in the same container. When it comes to styling these interactive bits—like the tab triggers and the primary call-to-action buttons—I want to steer clear of a few specific aesthetics I saw in my other open tabs. I definitely don't want the traditional, slightly rigid form controls with those subtle grey borders that I noticed on that daily symptom tracker page. At the same time, I also want to firmly avoid the hyper-modern, floaty look from that complex chart dashboard page, with its borderless white containers, heavy blurred drop shadows, and multi-colored pill tags. Instead, I'd prefer just straightforward, flat interactive elements with sharp or very slightly rounded corners and solid fill colors that change subtly when you hover over them. I want the UI to get out of the way of the content.

Further down the page, we need a dedicated section breaking down the main benefits and everyday use cases. For this specific part, the layout block-out from the page with the team headshots is exactly what I have in mind. I want a simple, centered section title, followed by a strict, highly structured three-column grid where every single card is equal in width and height. Each card will hold a minimal line-art icon and a brief explanatory paragraph. It keeps the visual rhythm of the page very predictable and extremely easy to scan. Speaking of that team headshots page, I also really want to capture how it makes you feel overall. It comes across as bright, clean, open, and incredibly approachable. I want my developer tool to give off that exact same welcoming energy, avoiding the intimidating feeling that technical tools often have. However, in terms of the actual colors, please avoid the harsh approach they took on the page with the bitcoin images. That stark, heavy contrast of the very dark navy top bar pressing down on a white background, combined with those bright teal accents, is way too intense for what I'm building. I'm leaning much more towards a softer, calmer palette, perhaps utilizing soft slate grays, warm off-whites, and muted blues that are easy on the eyes, especially for developers who might be reading this late at night. The whole page should ultimately feel like a calm, neatly organized workspace that respects the reader's time and attention.

user_prompt_en:
**Overview**
This document outlines the technical requirements for a single-page reading notes archive focused on historical recipes and culinary deconstructions. The architecture must utilize semantic HTML5, ensure high maintainability, and handle stateful content filtering entirely on the client side without full page reloads.

**Page structure**
- A top-level summary header with a stateful chronological filter bar.
- A dynamic CSS Grid gallery for historical recipe entries.
- A deep-dive reading notes segment. For this specific area, arrange the blocks like the white corporate overview page: give it massive amounts of structural whitespace, start with a large centered introductory paragraph, and flow into a relaxed, alternating layout where one column holds a photo and the opposite column holds the text.
- A collapsible reference bibliography at the footer.

**Visual**
- The color scheme needs to mirror that clean e-commerce site with the large header photo — strict stark white backgrounds, relying solely on grays and blacks for the UI elements, with absolutely no saturated accent colors. The only real color should come from the user-uploaded food photography.
- For text rendering, lift the styling directly from that dark page with the volcano landscape. Implement an extremely thin, Light-weight sans-serif font uniformly across both the display headings and the dense reading paragraphs to achieve that airy, floating visual weight.
- For the interactive elements and content containers, avoid the heavy-handed UI treatments I have open in other tabs. I do not want the harsh, thick black solid borders without rounded corners from that retro beige grid site, nor do I want the soft drop-shadowed white cards and colorful pill-shaped badges from that three-column inbox dashboard. Instead, rely purely on CSS layout gaps and invisible semantic wrappers without any visible borders or background fills, ensuring focus states use standard high-visibility browser outlines.

**Interaction**
- Implement a stateful view system where clicking a timeline tag dynamically cross-fades the visible entries, utilizing FLIP animations for smooth DOM reflows.
- Expandable `<details>` and `<summary>` accordions for the raw notes, allowing readers to toggle between the polished essay and the raw source text.
- Scroll-linked intersection observers to subtly fade in the alternating image and text blocks as they enter the viewport.

**Acceptance**
- The layout must hit responsive breakpoints at 768px and 1024px cleanly, switching the alternating columns to a stacked single column on mobile devices.
- Strict adherence to basic accessibility standards: all interactive elements must be keyboard-reachable (`Tab` sequence) in a logical DOM order.
- The ultra-thin typography must still meet a minimum contrast ratio against the stark white background to ensure readability.

user_prompt_en:
Here is the plan for a digital storefront for our neighborhood's upcycled furniture showroom, aimed at helping local families find accessible, low-cost pieces for their homes.
- We need the entire interface to be a single column scrolling straight down, with absolutely no multi-column layouts or side panels, ensuring it stays entirely straightforward for users on older mobile devices to read without needing to zoom or pan.
- Start the page with a welcoming header section that clearly states our mission, perhaps something like "Accessible living, one rebuilt table at a time", followed by a live data counter showing exactly how many items we have currently restored and ready for a new home in the warehouse.
- For the colors, use a dark grey that fades down into a deep dark blue background, keeping the text a stark white and using a bright, vibrant green exclusively for action buttons and active states, exactly matching the tones on that dark elevator floor selector page.
- Right below the header, I want an interactive filtering tool where users can drag a sliding scale to set their maximum room dimensions, and the page dynamically updates the available inventory below without ever needing to reload.
- Each piece of furniture should be displayed in a dedicated block that lists its name, the original source material, exact measurements in inches, and a short history of how our community volunteers repaired it, keeping the language transparent and honest.
- Make sure the text throughout uses a standard, modern sans-serif font, keeping the visual sizing hierarchy extremely clear with distinct main titles, moderate subheadings, and tiny, crisp labels for the dimension numbers, just like the clean text sizing on that server request heatmap screen.
- When a user taps a furniture photograph, it should trigger a stateful interactive view right there in the feed where they can swipe horizontally to spin the item 360 degrees, or toggle a button to overlay the exact width and height dimensions over the image so they know instantly if it fits their doorway.
- Keep the shapes of these item blocks, input fields, and buttons completely flat, built out of thin, solid black lines with harsh 90-degree corners, absolutely avoiding any rounded edges, drop shadows, or internal background color fills, identical to the bare geometric boxes on that black-and-white paper mill site.
- Include a live availability indicator for each item, which updates in real-time based on our inventory state, showing a bright green "Ready for Pickup" badge if it is in the shop, or a "Currently being varnished" status if it is still in the workshop area.
- At the bottom of the scroll, build a multi-step reservation form that changes state in place without reloading, asking first for the furniture item ID, then smoothly transitioning to a calendar for selecting a Saturday morning pickup slot, and finally capturing just their first name and a phone number for the volunteer driver to text.
- Ensure all the form fields have generously large touch targets and clearly explain what information is needed underneath them, keeping our promise of making the service as frictionless and accessible as possible for people who might not be incredibly tech-savvy.
- Finish the page with a simple footer listing our community workshop address, our open hours, and a plain text link to our volunteer application, keeping it entirely text-based without any distracting logos or heavy graphics.

user_prompt_zh:
**概述**
咱们增长团队这个季度主攻客单价提升，全新的「创作者通行证」账号设置中心就是最关键的阵地。别把它单纯当成一个配资料的后台，我们要把它做成一次高转化率的漏斗。用户进来不管是改密码还是查额度，首屏的视觉冲击和行动号召（CTA）必须第一时间抓住他们，顺滑地给他们种草高级版特权。另外强调一下工程侧的死命令：因为我们要把这个页面直接打进客户端安装包做本地预加载兜底，所以不允许有任何外链资源请求。所有的 CSS、JS、业务图表、SVG 图标必须百分之百封在一个独立的 HTML 文件里，拔掉网线也要能瞬间完整渲染。

**页面结构**
信息层级必须分明，减少用户寻找设置项的认知摩擦。这块我们就照着那个三栏邮件后台UI的架子来切分布局：
第一栏：最左侧给一个深色的极窄边栏，专门放高频模块的导航，比如“基础档案”、“用量大盘”、“账单与订阅”，外加底部常驻一个极具吸引力的升级按钮。
第二栏：中间放一个定宽的二级列表列，当用户在左边选中“账单与订阅”时，这里按时间轴列出历史各月份的卡片，或者不同子站点的独立入口。
第三栏：右边剩下最宽阔的大区域，用来承载所有的核心数据图表展现和复杂的表单录入，这是用户最主要的留存和转化操作区。

**视觉**
整个页面看过去的氛围，要像那套三栏邮件后台界面一样，透出一种现代高效、严密紧凑的专业 SaaS 工具气场，充满强烈的秩序感，让高净值的商业客户一看就觉得这笔钱花得值。
但是在文字的表现力上，必须要更有攻击性。去参考那个有横条视频和图片卡片的页面里的文字处理：页面里各个数据大模块的标题，必须给我上极大尺寸、极其粗壮厚实的无衬线体，跟底下的常规细字号说明文案形成那种极其强烈的视觉反差，把最重要的配额信息直接砸进用户眼睛里。
具体到卡片、表单这些小组件上，去抠那个彩色圆标落地页里的设计：给我用上那种特色鲜明的大尺寸实心彩色圆形底衬，里面套上白色的图标做功能指引，表单的输入框全做成半透明、低对比度的质感，再配合边缘极其干净的幽灵按钮，既有辨识度又不抢夺数据的风头。
这里特别提前避个雷，界面色彩绝对不能瞎用。我不想要那个白底浅色标签论坛的样子，大面积纯白底色就飘着一点极少量又极浅的灰蓝粉色点缀，太寡淡了完全没有能刺激转化的视觉锚点；也千万别搞得跟那个深色图标代码页一样，弄个深邃暗夜深蓝当底，上面全是明度极高、极其刺眼的青黄色发光点缀，那看着太冰冷太极客了。咱们的主色调要走能促成商业信任的路子，比如用高级的石墨灰或黛青色打底，但涉及“付费升级”和“容量见底”的数据条，必须用高饱和的活力橙和警戒红来提亮。

**交互**
右侧的“用量大盘”是本次 Upsell 的核心，必须通过前端状态切换做足动态反馈。
首先是资源消耗警报：顶部放置三个容量环形图（流量、存储、并发）。当用户在中间栏切换不同的历史月份时，这里不仅数字要实时更新，还要写纯前端的数字跳动和水波纹猛烈上涨的动效，直观传递出额度见底的紧迫感。
其次是流失挽回机制（Churn Prevention）：如果用户点击了不起眼的“降级订阅”，当前右侧区直接由前端控制铺上一层全屏的高斯模糊遮罩，弹出一个巨大的警示卡片。卡片倒计时 5 秒后才解锁确认按钮，同时抛出一个带有呼吸光晕动效的“保留当前档位赠 50G”专属特惠按钮。

**验收**
1. 脱网裸跑测试：彻底断开网络后强制刷新浏览器，要求所有功能、动效渲染正常，Network 面板不得有任何外部 CDN 或图片请求报错。
2. 沉浸式转化：所有涉及到方案试算和展开折叠的升级操作，必须利用纯前端状态树在当前视图内完成切换，不允许发生任何导致页面跳出的行为。
3. 图标合规：界面用到的所有指示性图标不得用外链图片或外部字体文件，全量转成 inline SVG 写入 DOM 结构中。

by_label.B: 现代高效、专业严谨的效率工具气场，界面紧凑充满秩序感，带有典型的商务 SaaS 氛围

user_prompt_en:
I'm building a product help center for my new creator tools, and since I care deeply about reading experience and proper archiving, I want it to feel like a well-crafted essay collection rather than a dry manual.
- Start with a dynamic search hero area that auto-suggests articles as you type, complete with a smooth one-click toggle to switch the whole site between dark and light modes.
- For the actual colors, grab the scheme from that bright page with the typewriter—the off-white background, dark grey text, and that nice mid-blue for the active links and highlights.
- I want the body text set at exactly 18px or larger, no exceptions, because anything smaller my mother cannot read.
- The main structure should just be a straightforward sticky table of contents on the left and the article on the right; skip that diagonal section splitting with the alternating round photos from that dark blue and grey page, I just need a clean, continuous reading column.
- Frame the category directory using the aesthetic from the dark page with the building—those translucent glass-like cards with the thin light borders, and use those fully rounded, pill-shaped cyan buttons for the support calls to action.
- Since most entries will be medium length, roughly half text and half images, bake in a fluid lightbox feature for clicking and expanding the tutorial screenshots.
- End each page with a stateful feedback widget that smoothly expands into a mini text form without reloading the window if someone clicks 'No'.

user_prompt_en:
We need a digital space for a new student-focused therapy collective, a place that feels structured yet intensely intimate and raw.
- I want the whole page on a dark ground with light text on it, to immediately signal a shift away from clinical, sterile university health centers and pull the user into a quiet, introspective headspace.
- The navigation should be stripped back to just the absolute essentials—"Our Approach", "The Team", and "Start Talking"—tucked away so it doesn't interrupt the narrative flow as the student arrives on the site.
- For the opening statement, the voice needs to hit hard and speak directly to academic and social burnout, so take the text treatment from the dashboard screenshot page: massive, ultra-thick geometric sans-serif headings crashing against very thin, light body copy to create a huge weight and size contrast.
- Below the fold, we need an "Our Approach" section that explains our sliding-scale fees and drop-in crisis hours without feeling like a dense syllabus or a corporate brochure.
- To organize this information, look at that vertical Chinese text page—I love how it abandons bulky conventional containers and instead uses those razor-thin crossing lines to divide the space, letting the text float in loose, whitespace-heavy columns alongside borderless data grids.
- We need a dedicated roster area introducing our five counselors, highlighting their specific focus areas like neurodivergence, academic pressure, and identity exploration in a way that feels deeply personal.
- Each counselor's profile should feature a raw, unfiltered black-and-white portrait followed by a short, first-person text bio, keeping the layout incredibly airy and deconstructed to match the grid aesthetic.
- The most critical piece of this build is the intake flow, which needs to be a multi-step responsive form where students can quietly select what they are struggling with, utilizing large touch targets for easy mobile tapping.
- When you build this booking form and the action triggers throughout the site, keep them radically brutalist and simple—none of that fussy stuff from the page with the dark top bar with its little blue linear gradients and slight drop shadows, and absolutely no fully rounded pill-shaped buttons or glossy app-store style badges like you see on the phone mockup page; just give me sharp, flat rectangles with hard corners that feel grounded and real.
- Include a section for emergency resources and late-night hotlines, formatted as a stark matrix that is instantly legible if someone is looking at it on a phone screen through tears at 2 AM.
- Ensure the responsive mobile experience doesn't lose this architectural tension; the thin intersecting lines should just re-stack cleanly, keeping the massive typography scaling down gracefully without losing its punch.
- The footer should serve as a grounding element, just offering the physical address near campus, basic hours, and a plain text link to our privacy commitment regarding university confidentiality.

by_label.A: 顶部全宽导航条，下方主体为固定宽度居中，划分为左侧主区和右侧窄边栏的典型双栏结构。
by_label.B: 单列通栏布局，内容集中在视口中央，大块居中标题下方紧跟一张几乎占满宽度的界面截图卡片。
by_label.C: 交替的通栏内容块，包含图文左右五五开（左文字右手机/左手机右文字），以及底部等宽三列居中排列。
by_label.D: 抛弃常规块状容器，依靠大量极细的直线交错来分割版面，包含纯靠留白组织的松散多列文本区和无边框表格。

layout.why: 第 4 份（D）极度依赖细线分割和极简无容器的留白排版，与普通网页的块状/响应式堆叠截然不同，极具辨识度。

by_label.A: 常规无衬线体，主标题字重偏中等（不极粗），层级过渡平缓，字距行距较为紧凑。
by_label.B: 使用几何感较强的无衬线体，主标题字号巨大且字重极粗，与偏淡且细的正文形成极其强烈的尺寸和重量对比。
by_label.C: 大标题使用醒目的粗黑衬线体（Serif），而副标题和正文保留无衬线体，形成明确的字体族碰撞。
by_label.D: 全局使用传统的中文衬线体（宋体/明体），混合了罕见的纵向排版，字号普遍偏小，呈现浓厚的学术/印刷物气质。

typography.why: 第 2 份（B）与A同为无衬线体主导，但B的标题极其粗大且几何化，与正文的反差显著强于A，能看出明显区别，但存在模型单纯用错字重的极小误判风险。

by_label.A: 典型特征为微小圆角的矩形按钮，表面带有明显的蓝白/浅蓝垂直线性渐变效果和轻微投影。
by_label.B: 页面有带青绿色渐变的小圆角按钮以及扁平的实心亮青色按钮。

user_prompt_zh: 这次我们在做一款面向结构工程师的专业计算类 iPad 应用下载页。出于现场工况使用的考量，这个页面呈现上受到严格限制，只能在 iPad 横屏状态下浏览，你需要帮我完成这版高交互强度的单页实现。界面的大框架上我已经确定好了，整个内容区我要左右两栏并排着看，左边固定展示核心信息，右边则是供用户上下滑动的详细参数与对比面板。作为主导体验的界面设计师，我对这种专业工具的视觉传达有比较明确的预设。你看那个深色的工程项目页面，它那种严谨、冷峻、硬朗的工业气息，以及整体透出来的沉稳厚重且具力量感的状态，正是我希望这款专业软件能传达给工程师的心理暗示。颜色也直接拿它那一套来用，以大面积近乎黑色的深灰色作为整个网页的底色，然后用那种极高饱和度的明黄色来做关键的视觉强调，比如主操作按钮、处于激活状态的标签，还有背景里隐约出现的高亮线框。字体的处理我希望跳出常规的粗黑体，你去看看那个米黄色的中文文档网页，里面的正文和主标题广泛使用了一种极具传统气质的中文衬线体，很像宋体的质感，字距和行距拉得非常疏朗宽阔，我们也要这样处理文字。不仅如此，在左侧栏的边缘或者大区块的衔接处，我也要加入它那种局部的竖排文字，用来做视线引导或者写几句软件的格言，靠这种文字排列的留白来提升阅读的呼吸感。不过到了具体的界面容器，我反而需要打破这种完全的冷硬。你找一下那个浅粉色渐变的婚庆页面，它里面那些小区块的样子挺好的，大量运用了带有柔和浅色投影的大圆角白色卡片，我要用这种卡片来装载复杂的表格数据。我们页面里的主操作按钮都要做成它那种全圆角的胶囊形状，包括底部的几个简单输入框也必须带上这种明显的圆角，以此来中和专业数据的枯燥感。接下来说说重点的右侧滑动区内容铺排。因为是专业工具，页面的内容体量非常大，基本是以表格和各种性能数字为主。滑动出来的第一个视觉焦点是个状态切换面板，通过复杂的微交互展示软件的渲染能力，里面有一组网格节点图，当鼠标划过或点击时，对应的线条会亮起明黄色的光并展示详细算力数据。紧接着往下是用来做转化钩子的核心功能，也就是价格与套餐的横向对比卡片。我们要在那张宽大的白底柔影大圆角卡片里放进专业版和企业版的对比表格，密密麻麻列出几十项参数指标，比如最大计算线程、云端存储空间上限等。这个区块顶部需要提供一个切换月度订阅和年度订阅的胶囊开关，重点是这里的交互，当我点击开关时，下面表格里的价格数字以及附带的配额不能直接生硬地闪现过去，必须带有数字平滑滚动增加或减少的动效过程，并且用亮色背景框短暂提示改变的数据。最后在页脚留一个表单区让访客申请企业试用，圆角输入框配上黄色胶囊按钮，点按提交的时候状态变化要细腻。整个页面的视线流必须靠间距节奏来控制，每个层级都要稳住。

by_label.A: 页面以大面积深灰色（近黑）作为底色，使用高饱和度的明黄色作为按钮、标签和高亮线框的强调色。
by_label.B: 整体使用暖调的米白/淡黄色作为单一背景色，文字和线条为深色，几乎没有高饱和度的色彩点缀。

palette.why: 第1份是典型的深色模式且带有强烈黄色对比，而其它两份均是浅色底色（图1对比图5、图9一眼可辨）。

by_label.A: 全局使用偏硬朗的现代无衬线字体，大标题采用全大写加粗形式，粗细对比和字号层级反差强烈。
by_label.B: 正文及标题广泛使用极具传统气质的中文衬线体（类似宋体），并包含大量竖排版文字，字距行距疏朗宽阔。
by_label.C: 采用圆滑纤细的现代无衬线字体，标题字重偏轻，排版具有呼吸感，整体呈现轻盈秀气的现代风格。

typography.why: 第2份大面积使用的传统中文衬线体和竖向排版极具辨识度，完全区别于第1、3份的常规横排无衬线体（图5对比图1、图10）。

by_label.A: 组件极简硬朗，按钮多为直角或极小圆角，没有使用弥散阴影，信息区块依靠简单的水平线和细边框分隔。
by_label.B: 几乎没有传统的UI组件（如卡片、按钮），界面元素的划分完全依赖于简单的单线表格（如排班表）和排版留白。
by_label.C: 大量运用带有柔和浅色投影的大圆角白色卡片来承载界面信息，主操作按钮为全圆角的胶囊形状，输入框也带有明显圆角。

component.why: 第3份包含明显的带有柔和阴影和大圆角的现代UI卡片与胶囊按钮，而第1份是直角无阴影，第2份则几乎没有卡片组件（图10/11对比图2、图7）。

by_label.A: 呈现出严谨、冷峻、硬朗的工业与工程气质，整体感觉沉稳厚重且具力量感。
by_label.B: 传递出宁静、克制、古典的情绪，具有强烈的书卷气与历史档案般的清冷感。
by_label.C: 散发着温馨、浪漫、轻盈的调性，给人一种现代、亲切且愉悦的松弛感。

atmosphere.why: 三者的情绪传达分别是硬朗工业（图1）、古典克制（图5）和浪漫温馨（图9），气场跨度极大，绝不可能混淆。

user_prompt_zh:
给街坊们做社区通讯的长文 Markdown 预览器，因为阅读体量大，整体交互和排版要兼顾沉浸感与编辑效率，具体实现要求如下：

- 整页底色我要深的，字必须直接浮在深底上，这点不妥协。
- 布局上我只要一个纯粹的双栏对称等宽视窗，左边沉浸输入，右边实时渲染，千万别像那个深色边栏的收件箱搞什么左中右固定侧边菜单栏，也别弄成最后那个带粉色字的图文页那种单列上下滚动的交替带状结构。
- 视窗中间需要一个带微交互的拖拽分割线，支持动态改变两栏配比，并且两侧长正文的滚动条要有精准的状态同步联动。
- 界面虽然暗，但阅读侧的氛围要像最开头那套带粉红按钮的浅色页面，极简克制，营造出一种文艺且舒缓放松的情绪，不能让使用者产生任何商业效率软件的压迫感。
- 顶部动作栏和各种悬浮控件的形制参考那个浅色大图页，不要做明显的卡片容器、不要阴影和物理描边边界，按钮全做成极小圆角的纯色实心扁平填充，保持页面呼吸感。

user_prompt_zh:
**业务概述**
我们要给自己的会计与税务事务所上线一个全新的单页官网，主要是面向海外做生意的英语客户。我们是做专业服务的，网站最核心的诉求就是看着正经、靠谱，而且绝对不能把联系方式藏着掖着，客人在任何地方停下来想找我们，都能一眼看到电话和办事处地址。

**页面结构**
结构安排上，我挺喜欢最后面带大首图那几张截图的做法：
1. 首屏直接放一张顶天立地的全宽大图，上面压上主推业务和最显眼的联系电话。
2. 往下滚动，先是一段通栏居中的简短介绍词。
3. 接着是具体的税务服务明细，做成图文交错排布的区块。
4. 核心合伙人团队的介绍，排成三列并排的网格。
5. 底部是长篇的合规说明和联系地址。

**视觉设计**
整个网站的氛围一定要开阔、舒展，带着点现代营销的视觉张力，就像那个大首图的展示页给人的感觉一样，让人觉得这家事务所很有底气和实力。
但在颜色上要完全换个路子。这毕竟是做税务，我相中了那个左侧带菜单的文档页的色彩方案：必须要大面积的留白，用浅灰色的背景块来区分不同的段落，文字链接和所有需要高亮的重点，全都只用它里面那种纯正的蓝色。
至于里面各种小方块和元素的处理，做成大首图页面里那种感觉：卡片要有强烈的悬浮立体感，所有的图片下面都得垫一层范围很宽、很柔和的弥散阴影，团队头像和页面里的社交图标全部裁切成正圆形的。
另外，这里有一个定死的规矩：正文我要宋体那种有横细竖粗的老派字，因为我们有大量的长正文需要阅读体验优先，用这种字读那些税务条款时才显得专业、压得住阵脚。

**交互体验**
咱们既然要建站，就得做出点高级感。在税务服务这块，我要加一个数据可视化的「企业税基模拟器」。客户拖拽一个收入区间的滑块，旁边的柱状图、适用的税率文本能实时平滑地切换状态，算出大概的数字。那些图文交错的区块在滚动进入屏幕时，也要有自然的滑入效果。

**验收标准**
1. 必须是一份单文件 HTML 代码，交付即用。
2. 纯英文面向海外用户，英文文本排版必须工整。
3. 必须满足基本无障碍要求，所有操作和状态切换都得支持键盘可达，文本和浅灰底色的对比度一定要够，确保大龄客户群体不戴老花镜也能看清。

user_prompt_en: We are building the hype pipeline for our Q3 product launch, and I need a countdown page that immediately grabs attention. I want it to feel like that dark night-sky playground page you have open—lively, a little mysterious, and full of playful energy. To nail that, let's use the exact colors from that same starry page: the deep purple and black cosmic background, punctuated by those glowing pink accents for the main headlines and calls to action, with maybe some bright, colorful floating elements scattered around the hero section. We have a massive, text-heavy manifesto to drop below the fold, so the reading experience has to be pristine. When arranging this long manifesto, please avoid that asymmetric split you see on the dark grey page where the big titles are cramped on the left and images sit on the right. I would much rather have a centralized, highly readable single-column flow for the heavy text portions so users never get distracted. And regarding the text itself, I definitely do not want the fonts from the art portfolio with the dark header—those tall, condensed sans-serifs and tiny red uppercase tags are awful for legibility. The same goes for the complex dashboard page; its dense, micro-sized data fonts will absolutely kill our conversion rate. Let's just use a clean, modern, generously sized geometric text that makes reading long paragraphs effortless on mobile or desktop. For the actual conversion path, we need a sticky navigation and a solid email capture form at the very end. When building the input fields and the final CTA, take a look at the ultra-clean white BINGO blog. I love how flat and integrated everything sits, resting directly on the background without clunky borders or box shadows, and those distinctive, fully rounded pill-shaped solid buttons are perfect. Let's do our inputs and buttons just like that, adjusting them to fit our dark purple background to complete the funnel.

ref_mix.label: A
ref_mix.looks_like: 一个深色星空背景的互动游戏或启动页，散落着各种可爱的小图标。

ref_mix.label: B
ref_mix.looks_like: 一个顶部有深灰色大区块、下方是大幅图片排版的艺术博客。

ref_mix.label: C
ref_mix.looks_like: 一个深蓝灰色的展示型单页，正文部分采用了明显的左文右图分栏。

ref_mix.label: D
ref_mix.handle: 带复杂图表的数据面板
ref_mix.looks_like: 一个包含大量彩色数据图表、表格和指标卡片的后台管理控制台。

ref_mix.label: E
ref_mix.looks_like: 一个极其干净的纯白底色博客或展示站，带有BINGO字样和亮青色按钮。

by_label.A: 游戏化的自由散落布局，元素在整个画布上随机分布，中间居中放置标题和开始按钮。
by_label.B: 顶部全宽深色区块，下方是类似瀑布流或不规则网格的大尺寸图片排版，图片紧密相邻。
by_label.C: 往下滚动时呈现明显的非对称左右分栏，左栏较窄用于放置大标题和说明文字，右栏较宽用于放置对应的配图和次级内容。
by_label.D: 固定的左侧深色导航栏，右侧主内容区是密集的网格系统，由多个尺寸不一的区块拼接而成。
by_label.E: 居中的顶部主图区（带有文字叠加），下方是标准的三列等宽网格图文列表，底部FAQ呈单列文本平铺。

layout.why: 第3份（C）非对称的“左侧标题栏+右侧内容/图片”排版结构特征明确，与其他几份的全宽居中、均匀网格或复杂后台布局差异明显，易于判别是否被模仿。

by_label.A: 深紫黑色星空背景，带有粉色的主标题和按钮，散落各种明亮彩色的小动物图标。
by_label.B: 主体为纯白背景，顶部有一个深灰黑色的宽大区块，使用鲜红色作为辅助色（标签边框、图标、按钮）。
by_label.C: 整体背景为偏暗的深蓝灰色，侧边栏颜色更深，文字偏灰白，带有少量的暗红色实心按钮和细线点缀。
by_label.D: 浅灰色/白色主背景，左侧边栏为深蓝色，内容区有大量高饱和度的鲜艳色块和图表（亮蓝、粉、绿、深红等）。
by_label.E: 纯粹的白底黑字，唯一显眼的主题强调色是亮青色（Cyan），专门用于按钮。

palette.why: 第1份（A）独特的深紫/粉色系霓虹感配色与其余所有的常规亮色或暗色系企业/博客配色截然不同，极易区分。

by_label.A: 极其圆润、活泼的加粗展示型无衬线字体，全小写，具有游戏特有的趣味感。
by_label.B: 顶部大标题使用较瘦长的无衬线体，正文为标准大小，红色小标签的字号非常小且全大写。
by_label.C: 深色背景下的细体无衬线字，标题和正文的粗细对比不强烈，整体感觉轻盈偏暗。
by_label.D: 典型的数据面板字体，大量使用极小字号的无衬线体以容纳密集数据，通过轻微加粗和颜色深浅来区分表头和数值。
by_label.E: 标题使用了非常粗重、醒目的黑色无衬线体，与下方常规细体的灰色正文形成了非常强烈的粗细和色彩对比。

typography.why: 第2份（B）是带大标题的常规博客排版，第4份（D）是密集的微小数据排版。两者的使用场景和字号/密度特征完全不同，且都有别于A的卡通字和E的极度粗细反差。作为反面点名，足以要求模型避开“细碎数据风”和“常规粗体博客风”。

by_label.A: 具有发光质感的粉紫色渐变圆角药丸状按钮，散落的图标没有边框或背景承载。
by_label.B: 直角或微圆角的红色实心按钮，深色区有细红线边框的透明标签，图片直接展示，无卡片感。
by_label.C: 带有白色细线框的透明幽灵按钮和浅红色的实心微圆角按钮。
by_label.D: 大量的组件被包裹在带有极轻微灰色阴影的纯白直角卡片容器中。
by_label.E: 具有辨识度的亮青色全圆角（药丸形）实心按钮，博客列表的图文直接在白底上排列，没有边框或阴影将其包裹成卡片。

component.why: 第5份（E）的青色药丸按钮和无阴影边框的纯平图文罗列风格足够清晰，与D的重卡片感、C的线框按钮有显著区别，但因其本身较为极简，生成结果若过于常规可能存在轻微误判风险。

by_label.A: 充满童趣与轻松感的夜空游乐场氛围，活泼可爱且带点神秘。
by_label.B: 具有艺术张力和视觉冲击力的浓烈、热情氛围。
by_label.C: 沉稳内敛、带有些许严肃克制感的现代商务氛围。
by_label.D: 理性、严谨、信息密集的效率工具氛围。
by_label.E: 清新、透气、文艺闲适的现代生活方式氛围。

atmosphere.why: 第1份图是极度显眼可爱的童趣休闲气场，与后续几份的艺术、商务、工具、极简文艺气场有着根本性的差异，一眼即可分辨。

user_prompt_zh:
我正在为一场面向中老年群体的银发科技赋能峰会设计官方网站。考虑到受众群体的特殊性，我们在呈现约束上必须坚持移动端优先，以窄屏的单手握持体验为核心来推敲所有的间距节奏与信息层级。页面的文字呈现上，我希望借鉴那个带大号左侧导航栏页面的做法，建立极具张力的视觉对比，针对峰会的主标题和核心口号使用巨大且粗重的纯黑衬线体来镇住视觉重心，而正文段落和具体的议程时间表则采用非常干净轻量的无衬线体，不过考虑到长辈的视力，基础字号需要做全局的放大处理，确保足够的易读性。

在整个页面的区域划分上，当用户在较宽的屏幕上浏览时，我希望采用那个有右边侧栏的绿色版块里的做法，形成一种主次分明的两栏结构。左侧大面积区域用来承载上午和下午的详细峰会议程，右侧的小组件侧栏则固定悬浮报名表单和嘉宾导览，在界面的下半部分再平铺一个规整的多列网格来展示十二位核心演讲者的信息。整个页面给人的感觉也要像那个有右边侧栏的绿色版块一样，必须是明亮、轻松且充满人情味与亲和力的，我们要用这种日常通俗感来消除老年人面对硬核科技大会时的紧张心理。

对于具体的界面元素，比如那些卡片和输入控件的长相，我觉得那个深黑底紫蓝渐变卡片页里的设计非常抓人。我们需要在核心嘉宾信息区使用那种带有微弱反光和亮色描边质感的深灰色圆角卡片，以此来提升局部界面的精致度与包裹感，同时峰会的首屏报名操作入口一定要使用它里面那种极其抢眼的高饱和紫蓝渐变实心按钮，让行动号召在视觉上绝对聚焦。但是在全局的色彩覆盖上我要特别强调一点，我绝对不想要那张纯黑底发光粒子特效图里那种极端的纯黑色和刺眼的高亮发光色，也受不了那个带深黑波浪底栏的白页里大面积死白配黑灰色底栏那种缺乏生机的冷漠感。我们的网页背景应该使用温暖柔和的米白色，配上沉稳的暖棕色文字，从而确保长时间阅读的舒适度。

最后是关于页面里的微小反馈与内容细节。我们需要引入一些不干扰阅读的视觉提示，首屏主视觉区需要一个基于实时数据的动态倒计时模块，背景可以配合一段平滑过渡的柔和波纹视差滚动。当用户在左侧的议程列表中切换不同峰会日期时，内容区要有阻尼感适中的平滑过渡。页面的尾部区域需要接入一个数据可视化的模块，用一个支持触控拖拽的轻量级动态图表来展示往届峰会覆盖的社区数量和适老化设备的普及比例，所有图表节点在手指点击时都要有清晰的提示气泡响应，确保在移动端窄屏下的每一次触摸反馈都精准无误。

ref_mix.label: A
ref_mix.handle: 纯黑底发光粒子特效图
ref_mix.looks_like: 这是一个背景为全黑，中央显示一团类似交互式粒子发光特效的实验性演示页面。

ref_mix.label: B
ref_mix.handle: 带深黑波浪底栏的白页
ref_mix.looks_like: 这是一个常规的商业服务落地页，大面积白底，包含了带阴影的下拉菜单和深黑色的波浪形状底部。

ref_mix.label: C
ref_mix.handle: 有右边侧栏的绿色版块
ref_mix.looks_like: 这组包含了带有明显右侧功能边栏的博客版块、多列网格课程卡片以及半截团队成员展示。

ref_mix.label: D
ref_mix.handle: 带大号左侧导航栏页面
ref_mix.looks_like: 这组包含了极简的细字图文排版、人像网格，以及一个有着宽大左侧导航栏的粗体标题区块。

ref_mix.label: E
ref_mix.handle: 深黑底紫蓝渐变卡片页
ref_mix.looks_like: 这是一个暗色模式的产品展示页，使用了深黑/深灰卡片并点缀以大面积的高饱和紫蓝渐变色。

by_label.A: 全屏仅有中心一个视觉元素堆叠，没有任何栏位、内容区块划分或信息层级排列。
by_label.B: 采用了标准的通栏单列堆叠布局，各信息区块自上而下排列，未见明显的侧边栏结构。
by_label.C: 采用了明显的主内容区搭配右侧小组件（搜索框、简介卡片）侧边栏的两栏式布局，下半部还有规整的多列网格。
by_label.D: 包含了图片与文字等宽对齐的两列排版，以及一个将菜单独立放置在整个左侧的大栏位布局。
by_label.E: 采用单列通栏布局，主要元素居中放置并在下方平铺并排卡片，没有侧边辅助栏位。

layout.why: 第 3 份（C）在图7中展示了典型的右侧悬浮/小组件边栏布局，这是其余所有只使用单列通栏或左侧导航栏的参考页面中所没有的，特征极其容易辨认。

by_label.A: 使用了极端的纯黑色作为整体背景，画面完全由粒子特效产生的高亮发光色（白、黄、紫粉）充当主导色。
by_label.B: 以大面积的纯白色为背景，搭配深黑色/深灰色的块状底栏，全局基本为黑白灰，缺乏任何明显的彩色点缀。
by_label.C: 以大面积白底为主，采用了高明度、高饱和的薄荷绿/翠绿色作为贯穿始终的主色调和强调色。
by_label.D: 背景为带些微灰度的白，文字多为中深灰，极其克制地只在短划线或极小图标上点缀了少许红色和蓝色。
by_label.E: 以极暗的深灰或纯黑为背景主调，使用了极为鲜艳明亮、大面积铺陈的紫蓝色渐变作为核心品牌色与强调色。

palette.why: 第1份(极暗背景配发光色)和第2份(极简大白底配深黑底栏的无彩色系)在底色倾向和色彩丰富度上处于两个极端，且彼此完全不同，下游模型很容易避开这两种死板的用色。

by_label.A: 几乎不包含实质性文字，仅在顶部有一排极其微小、低对比度的无衬线导航控制文本。
by_label.B: 全局使用常规企业站风格的无衬线体，标题加粗，正文较细，具有中规中矩的字号层级和字重对比。
by_label.C: 均采用无衬线字体，字号与字重适中，特色在于部分标题（如“color”）使用了醒目的绿色横线进行高亮强调。
by_label.D: 混合使用了极其纤细/轻量的无衬线正文，以及一个巨大、粗重醒目的纯黑色衬线体（Serif）大标题，反差极为强烈。
by_label.E: 全篇采用充满现代感的无衬线字体，特色是大标题使用了极粗的字重（超粗体），配合大字号形成强烈的视觉冲击。

typography.why: 第 4 份（D）在图12中出现了体量巨大的粗黑“衬线”字体大标题，这一字族特征在满是无衬线字体的其他所有参考页面中鹤立鸡群，一对比就能分清。

by_label.A: 除了页面顶部极其微小的纯文本控制按钮外，不存在任何实质意义上的常规网页交互组件或容器。
by_label.B: 主要组件为带有浅色柔和阴影的白色方块面板（如导航下拉框），风格扁平轻量。
by_label.C: 组件以纯白背景带轻微阴影的容器卡片为主，按钮组件呈现为鲜艳的绿色圆角实心矩形或空心描边状。
by_label.D: 几乎不使用明显的边框或深色底色块来包裹信息，内容如同“裸露”在页面上，按钮退化为极其简单的蓝底小方块。
by_label.E: 大量使用深灰色底并带有微弱反光/亮色描边质感的暗黑圆角卡片，以及极其抢眼的紫蓝色高饱和渐变实心按钮。

component.why: 第 5 份（E）所展现的“暗色微光描边卡片”搭配“高亮紫蓝渐变按钮”属于非常明确的现代暗黑UI质感，与其他几份白底清汤寡水的组件风格差异巨大。

by_label.A: 极其先锋、实验性且充满神秘感的纯视觉互动氛围
by_label.B: 极其冷峻、克制、甚至略显生硬的现代商务极简感
by_label.C: 明亮、轻松、充满人情味与亲和力的日常通俗感
by_label.D: 深邃、前卫、带有明显光影质感的高级科技炫酷气场
by_label.E: 沉稳、复古、结构严谨的传统报纸期刊阅读质感

atmosphere.why: 第 3 份（C）散发着明亮亲切的生活化气息，与其他几份的先锋实验（A）、冷峻克制（B）、高端深色科技（D）以及复古严谨（E）形成了完全不同维度的情绪对比，极易分辨。

user_prompt_zh:
**概述**：
我们要推一个新的开源项目主页，主要做开发者获客。整体诉求就是转化路径要短平快，体验上要像用 Vercel 托管服务一样——没那么多废话，主打一键接入的爽快感。为了保证转化率，首屏的冲击力和引导必须极其直接，核心的注册表单和CTA必须在首屏一屏内完整看完，严禁出现需要向下滚动才能看见重点的情况。

**页面结构**：
包含导航、多个功能板块介绍和底部收集表单，要求全站响应式。大框架就看带左侧菜单的文档那个截图，左侧是固定宽度的菜单目录，右侧留出较宽的主内容区，里面的图文和表单等元素单列从上往下顺着排。

**视觉**：
我们自己的主色是 #B91C1C 这个色号，按这个来。文字呈现的感觉抓一下绿地小人的游戏图里的面板字，就是那种非常纯粹的普通细黑体，字号差不多大就行，不需要搞夸张的标题大小层级对比。
另外，卡片和输入框千万别搞有数据折线图那份里那种大圆角加柔和阴影的浮夸风，也真受不了黑白复古人像网格那种连外边框都没有、仅靠几根极细灰线的薄弱输入框。我要最标准、带清晰实线外框的硬朗表单和按钮，交互区必须直白。

**交互**：
右侧内容区下拉时，左侧导航条固定不动并随进度高亮。

**验收**：
首屏视口高度内必须穷尽转化焦点。移动端下侧边栏需自动折叠收起。

user_prompt_en:
**Overview**
This document serves as the initial technical specification and product requirements for a new single-page application (SPA). The product is a premium class schedule booking platform designed exclusively for our advanced architecture and industrial design masterclasses. As the lead frontend engineer on this project, I want to establish clear structural boundaries before we start writing the DOM logic. A crucial constraint right out of the gate: this application is strictly targeted for iPad landscape usage, primarily intended for kiosk mounts in our physical studios and for our instructors' tablets. Do not build this for mobile phones or desktop monitors; if the viewport is below 1024px wide or in a portrait aspect ratio, we will just show a hard block overlay. We are optimizing the entire experience for a wide, horizontal canvas.

**Layout Architecture**
The visual hierarchy of the SPA needs to be highly predictable. At the top of the interface, we require a strongly centered introductory block containing the academy's current manifesto, seasonal branding, and a brief text overview of the upcoming semester. Directly beneath this centered header block, I want the main browsing interface organized precisely like that clean white blog page I had open earlier—it needs to fall into a rigid, symmetrical three-column grid of equal-width cards. That specific geometric rhythm is perfect for allowing prospective students to scan multiple course offerings at once without feeling overwhelmed. The grid should leverage modern CSS Grid properties (`grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr)`) with a healthy, mathematically consistent gap to ensure the layout remains breathable and structurally sound.

**Visual Execution**
Our conversion strategy relies heavily on establishing academic authority, so the text rendering needs to do a lot of heavy lifting. I want you to pull the typographic treatment straight from that heavy bordered Chinese science poster page. Give me that exact massive, commanding scale for the main headers—huge, ultra-bold display fonts that punch through the screen with a stark print-poster impact, creating an aggressive contrast against the highly readable, standard-weight body copy. It should feel less like a standard web app and more like a high-end editorial broadsheet.

Regarding the color palette: while I was reviewing our reference materials, I spent some time looking at that dark corporate page with the full-bleed transit photos, and it made me realize how much I actively dislike that specific combination of heavy charcoal backgrounds paired with those bright salmon and orange highlight colors. Please completely avoid that entire scheme. Instead, I want a highly restrained, architectural palette. Stick to cool concrete greys, stark paper whites, and perhaps a single muted slate blue for focusing interactive states.

Furthermore, I have a strict, non-negotiable rule for the UI components: I want absolutely zero box shadows on any of the cards, modals, or form fields. I despise that floating, elevated drop-shadow look, full stop. Keep every single element aggressively flat and grounded, relying strictly on 1px solid borders for spatial definition.

**Content and State Management**
Unlike standard transactional booking sites, our users need to digest a massive amount of information before committing to a $2,000 seminar. The content volume here involves lots of long-form text, and the reading experience must be prioritized above all else. When a user interacts with a course card in the three-column grid, it must trigger a complex stateful view—expanding into a wide split-screen modal using the native HTML5 `<dialog>` element.

Inside this expanded view, the user will read through multi-paragraph instructor philosophies, detailed week-by-week curriculum breakdowns, and extensive prerequisite reading lists. The line height (aim for `1.6` to `1.8`), paragraph spacing, and line lengths (strictly capped at around 70 characters) must be optimized to prevent eye fatigue during these deep reading sessions. Semantic tags like `<article>`, `<section>`, and `<aside>` must be utilized perfectly to maintain a healthy document outline for assistive technologies.

**Interactive Booking Flow**
The actual transaction is a highly interactive, multi-step process that must occur entirely inline without any page reloads. Inside the expanded course view, users will interact with a custom-built calendar interface to select their preferred cohort dates.
*   Clicking a date should smoothly animate a selection state, updating a dynamic JavaScript array tracking the cart in the background.
*   As dates are toggled, a sticky floating summary panel on the right side of the screen must instantly calculate the total tuition, material fees, and applicable early-bird discounts in real-time.
*   The transition between the main grid and the expanded booking state should utilize well-structured CSS transitions to scale and fade smoothly, avoiding any jarring context switches.

**Technical Acceptance Criteria**
*   Deliverable must be a single, self-contained HTML file containing all necessary CSS and JavaScript. No external asset dependencies other than standard web fonts.
*   The stylesheet must be modular, utilizing CSS custom properties defined at the `:root` level for all design tokens (spacing scale, typography scale, color hexes).
*   JavaScript must be written cleanly in ES6+ without frameworks, handling the complex state of the booking cart, calendar selections, and dynamic pricing.
*   Responsive constraints are strictly enforced: the UI assumes a minimum viewport of `1024x768`. Any smaller screen must trigger a "Please rotate your device to landscape" overlay, built using standard media queries.

user_prompt_en:
I am putting together a single-page web app for a high-end restaurant reservation system, and I need a pristine, semantic HTML structure that is highly maintainable and optimized for performance. The top of the page should feature a clean navigation bar with links to Our Story, Seasonal Menus, Chef's Table, and a direct anchor to the booking section. Below that, the hero area needs to make a bold statement introducing the restaurant. I am looking at the provided images, and the one with the super heavy black titles has exactly the text treatment I want here. You should apply that extreme weight contrast throughout our page, using massively thick, ultra-bold sans-serif fonts for the main headlines, and placing them right alongside very fine, light-colored body text. That intense contrast between the heavy headings and the delicate paragraphs establishes exactly the right visual hierarchy.

Right below the hero, we transition into the core booking experience. I want the content area split into two side-by-side columns for this section. The left column will house the interactive reservation form, requiring fields for the guest's desired date, seating time, party size, full name, email address, phone number, and a text area for any dietary restrictions or special occasion notes. The right column will serve as a sticky summary panel, displaying the selected details in real-time alongside our cancellation policy and a subtle reminder about our dress code. Of course, you will need to implement proper responsive breakpoints so this strict dual-column arrangement collapses gracefully on mobile screens.

When styling the interactive pieces of this form and the surrounding containers, look at the other reference page—the one with the pink gradient top bar. I love the incredibly sharp, flat look of its interface elements. Use those ultra-thin, light gray borders for all our input fields and summary cards, and make sure the corners are almost entirely square, with practically zero radius. Avoid adding drop shadows entirely to keep the interface feeling flat and technical. The buttons in the form, especially the main submit trigger, should follow the same pattern, either appearing as very fine outline boxes or solid, compact dark squares.

After the reservation block, the page needs a visually engaging section showcasing the dining room and signature dishes. We will build a tightly packed photo grid here. This section must include a specific interaction where clicking on any of the small gallery thumbnails expands the image into a large, full-screen viewing overlay. Ensure the markup for this gallery is completely semantic so the interaction feels native and lightweight without relying on bloated external libraries. Finally, anchor the page with a comprehensive footer that includes our physical address, valet parking instructions, contact email, and standard terms of service, ensuring the whole file remains a single, clean artifact ready for production.

layout.why: 第 4 份放弃了所有现代网页的网格和卡片容器，呈现出极具辨识度的古典纸媒留白式排版，与前两份的常规商业网页布局截然不同。

by_label.A: 整体暗黑主题，以非常深的蓝黑色为底色，文字主色为白色和浅灰，使用明亮的黄色作为按钮和列表图标的强调色。
by_label.B: 干净的亮色主题，纯白或极浅灰底色，主文本为接近黑色的深灰，以略偏灰的鲜绿色作为按钮和标题小字的强调色。
by_label.C: 使用了大面积、高饱和度的从蓝紫向粉红过渡的渐变色作为全局背景，无其他辅助色，仅配以纯白文字。
by_label.D: 温和的低对比配色，使用类似宣纸的浅米色/暖灰底色，文字为深棕/深灰色，偶尔点缀极其微小的暗红色（如小方块修饰）。

palette.why: 第 3 份是全屏高饱和度的霓虹渐变色，没有具体的实色区块划分，与其他三份的纯色底（深蓝、纯白、浅米）对比极其强烈且无法混淆。

by_label.A: 使用无衬线字体，标题字重为粗体但不过分夸张，字间距正常，正文清晰规整，整体传递严肃专业的企业感。
by_label.B: 使用几何无衬线字体，主标题（如 Business Loans）使用了极其粗重（Black/Heavy级别）的字重，与细浅色正文形成了非常夸张的字号和字重反差。
by_label.C: 仅有一处文本，使用了超粗的无衬线英文字母，字间距较宽，带有明显的白色外发光阴影特效。
by_label.D: 全面使用中文衬线体（类似宋体/明朝体），字号普遍偏小，行距很大，标题与正文的字号与字重差异极其微弱，气质内敛古朴。

typography.why: 第 2 份“极粗黑大标题对比细浅小正文”的现代无衬线风格非常典型，与 D 的衬线体、C 的发光字绝不混淆；但有一定风险模型仅理解为“无衬线”，从而做得不够极端，与 A 产生轻微相似。

by_label.A: 大量使用带有明显大圆角的深色卡片作为内容容器（比底色稍亮的深蓝色区块），按钮为两端完全半圆的黄色胶囊状，包含带边框的折叠面板（Accordion）。
by_label.B: 容器感极弱，没有明显的底层卡片，按钮是带较小圆角的绿色矩形实心块，图片本身带有细微圆角，使用扁平的单色图标。
by_label.C: 页面中不存在任何常规交互组件（如按钮、输入框、卡片等），只有纯文本。
by_label.D: 完全摒弃了面状的容器或按钮组件，所有信息的分割仅依靠极其纤细的浅色单横线实现，无背景色块填充，无任何边框或阴影。

component.why: 第 1 份的大圆角微凸起深色卡片面板和高对比度的黄色胶囊按钮具有极强的几何形态特征，在四份参考中独一无二。

by_label.B: 通透、常规的现代商业气场，偏向明快和轻松的交流感。

user_prompt_en:
**Overview**: We need a marketing landing environment for our new ascetic-focused yoga studio. It's a single-page application with stateful schedule views and instructor availability toggles, deploying via Vercel for instantaneous edge updates, though the core vibe is purely minimalist ascetic.

**Page structure**: I want the spatial blocking from that dark forum page. Set it up with the top navigation bar, then a strict split beneath it—a wide left column for the main flow and a narrower right-hand sidebar for quick bookings.

**Visual**: We are keeping the visual hierarchy extremely austere. For the hues, take them strictly from the beige grid one: use that vast warm off-white background and pair it with pure black text and dividing lines. Strictly monochrome, no extra emphasis colors. Also, I want the body text at 18px or larger, full stop—anything smaller my mother cannot read.

**Interaction**: The micro-interactions need high fidelity. For all actionable targets—cards, inputs, and primary triggers—I want the exact execution from the last set of shots with the neon buttons. Give me those heavy glass-morphism pill shapes with the intense colored outer glow and gradients. The main viewport requires a sticky anchor navigation that triggers scroll highlighting as users scrub through the flow.

**Acceptance**: Component consistency across the booking states; the scroll-spy logic fires without layout shifting; all text scales perfectly at 18px minimum without breaking the right sidebar constraint.

user_prompt_zh:
**项目概述与增长目标**

本次开发任务是落地一个**高客单价视频课程（AIGC 企业级落地实战）的试听转化页**。作为前端首层的营销阵地，我们极度看重首屏冲击力和转化路径的最短化。目标流量不仅要能沉浸式体验试听内容，还必须被顺滑地引导至留资表单。整体内容体量属于中等篇幅，往下滚动时图文信息各占一半。请基于单文件 HTML 输出，兼顾桌面端和移动端体验。

**首屏动线与全局骨架**

你提供的这组设计图给了我很好的启发，那套左右分栏的结构简直完美适配我们的播放场景，**我们要原封不动地照搬那个布局骨架**。整个页面要在屏幕中居中对齐，左侧的大面积主展示区（即原图里放多边形图表的位置）用来承载我们的核心——「视频播放器」；右侧的控制面板区（原图放滑块的地方）用来做「选集导航与表单转化」。

- **顶部导航（常驻）**：极简风格，左侧是品牌 Logo「AI-Mastery」，右侧放一个高亮的 CTA 按钮「立即解锁全套课程」，锚点直达底部留资区。
- **自适应要求**：桌面端保持这个双视窗并排的精致感，但在移动端必须优雅降级，右侧的目录与表单模块要顺滑折叠到视频下方，绝不能出现横向滚动条。

**视觉质感与组件规范**

这组截图里的整体气质非常符合我们想要的科技感与专业度，那种深邃的数据可视化氛围请直接带入到新页面里。

- **色彩体系**：直接借用参考图的那种深蓝灰作为暗黑模式底色，配合他们用的那个发光的紫调作为品牌主色。不过因为我们是营销导向，主转化按钮和关键数据（比如“已购人数 12,000+”）的配色，你需要稍微调整一下，加一点高对比度的亮橙色或渐变色来刺激点击，不要像原图那样全部冷色调。
- **排版与字号**：字体排版的克制感直接照搬。标题的加粗层级、辅助说明文字的字号衰减、无衬线字体带来的清爽感，都要完全保留。文字间距要保持呼吸感。
- **组件样式**：右侧面板里的卡片圆角、淡淡的描边与内阴影质感、以及预设按钮（像图里那个 Manager 按钮）那种带着微光的实心/线框样式，请一丝不苟地复刻过来，应用到我们的课程目录列表和输入框上。

**核心转化板块与文案设定**

请在页面中填充真实营销向的内容结构，不要用 Lorem Ipsum：

1.  **左侧视听区**：
    - 放置一个 16:9 比例的 HTML5 视频占位符，默认展示一张带有播放 icon 的高品质封面图（暗黑科技风）。
    - 视频下方跟上课程标题：**《AIGC 生产力引擎：从 0 到 1 构建企业知识库》**。
    - 紧跟一行关键指标：**4.9/5 评分 · 120+ 课时 · 涵盖 5 大工业级落地场景**。
    - 再往下是图文并茂的课程详情（图文各半），一段讲师资历，配两张架构大纲图。
2.  **右侧转化区**：
    - **选集面板**：标题为「试听章节 (3/15)」。用参考图中滑块和按钮的精致组件风格，做三个可点击的试听课列表项（例如：“01. 提示词工程的底层逻辑”、“02. 知识库 Agent 搭建实操”等）。
    - **留资表单**：列表紧贴着下方是一个卡片表单。包含「姓名」、「手机号」和一个下拉框「公司规模」。底部放置全宽的主 CTA 按钮「获取完整实战源码与课件」。

**用户触点交互设计**

交互动效的细腻程度直接影响转化率，这块我们要对标截图里的动态反馈水准：

- **状态联动**：就像截图里点击不同按钮（比如点 Randomize 或预设项）会导致图表平滑重绘一样，我们的用户在右侧点击不同的「试听章节」时，左侧的视频主图、当前高亮的播放标题必须做到无缝且丝滑的切换动效，不要生硬跳转。
- **Hover 细节**：原图里鼠标悬停时出现的浮层和亮度变化非常棒。请在我们的章节列表悬停、表单输入框 focus 以及播放器控件悬停时，都加上这种带有光晕感或背景色微调的反馈。

**研发侧验收标准**

1.  **单文件交付**：所有 CSS 与轻量化交互 JS 必须内联在同一个 HTML 文件中，方便我们直接投放系统。
2.  **性能约束**：考虑到是落地页，加载必须要快，代码不要太臃肿，杜绝引入超大型第三方动画库，用原生 CSS transition 解决所有 hover 和切换动效。
3.  **兼容性验证**：表单在移动设备唤起键盘时不得遮挡主按钮；所有交互状态（包括选集的高亮状态）在控制台报错数为零。

user_prompt_zh:
需要开发一个「全民数据洞察马拉松」答题闯关活动页，页面主要包含赛事导航、闯关主流程表单以及实时的成就数据统计区。

- 整个站的区块铺排就按那个带音箱大图的落地页来做，采用经典的单列垂直向下堆叠排版，每个业务区块的边界要切分得很分明。
- 首屏大标题居中排布，紧接着放一张通栏的赛事全景图，往下滚动到具体的积分规则说明区时，做成图文左右五五平分的常规排列结构。
- 首屏上方加一个固定的全局响应式导航条，右侧放一个主题切换控件，因为项目最终交付需要能支持明暗两套主题可无缝切换，不过默认的整页底色我要深的，所有的字都直接浮在深底上。
- 往下进入核心的「答题赛段」区块，这里需要一个带进度指示器的分步提交表单，题目包括对DAU、转化率等指标异常波动的归因单选题。
- 表单展示的容器去看看带渐变色块的现代页，我要里面的那种带有大尺寸圆角的悬浮卡片，而且卡片四周必须要有向外柔和扩散开的显著彩色大投影。
- 底部那个「提交并看下一题」的主按钮也照里面的做，用那种非常亮眼突出的青绿荧光渐变色。
- 答题表单的右侧需要悬浮一个当前的实时仪表盘，用来监控当前的连击准确率、耗时进度和同期预测排位。
- 这个仪表盘里的文本说明和排行榜文字，要完全照着那个带深色侧栏的数据板来排。就是要注重数据呈现的那种紧凑感，整体的字号偏小，行间距小。
- 特别是各个模块的标题（就像它那个All Exam Result表头一样）和列表正文之间，字号的反差要尽量弱化，体现出一种密集、理性的数字特征。
- 闯关结束后会进入「成绩结算」通栏区，调用Echarts渲染一个个人能力雷达图，展示在「SQL基础」、「异动分析」、「A/B测试」等五个维度的表现分。
- 页面最底部的全国总榜单必须提供多维度的交互筛选器，允许参赛者按区域、业务线、得分区间进行动态过滤查询，确保图表和名单时刻准确且方便查阅。

user_prompt_zh: 我们需要开发一个新的实验结果对比页，主要用于科研团队内部比对不同参数下的模型表现。作为技术文档库的一部分，这个页面的信息结构必须极其清晰，能够高效检索且适合长篇阅读。空间的划分我想参考那个带顶部搜索框的图文页，做得极致简化一些。页面的最顶端只需要孤零零地留出一个全局检索框，不要放多余的任何导航条。往下走，主体内容区域采用一种单列居中的结构，最上面先放一张占满整个内容宽度的核心对比走势大图，紧接着在这张大图正下方，跟着一段和它完全等宽的单列长文本块，用来书写详细的实验结论和模型运行日志。这种不被两侧边栏打扰的沉浸式页面非常适合我们看长篇的技术说明。画面的颜色我相中了那个横幅带深色遮罩的多列页，整体那种明亮干净的感觉很不错，背景和一些高亮区域就直接用它那种浅绿色和淡灰色。为了让顶部的核心对比走势大图视觉上更聚焦，我想在数据图表这块区域加上类似那个多列页顶部大图所用的深色半透明遮罩层，让页面的明暗有个对比递进。在文字呈现方面，我们要追求那种纯文本带表格的报告网页里透出来的学术质感。全篇都要使用经典的衬线字体来输出，营造出一种强烈的传统印刷排印感觉。各级标题和正文之间的字重区分要尽量克制，千万不要反差太大，另外对于关键的实验变量名称或者特殊术语，需要有小型大写字母的运用，这样能在保持文档正式感的同时提升阅读者的体验。页面里的一些控制小件，咱们参照那个带有亮蓝实心按钮的网页里的细节来处理。比如用于切换不同数据维度或者网络层的控制键，就做成它那种直角或者微圆角的实心扁平按钮。我们的对比大图如果要实现多组数据结果的自动轮播展示，底下的进度点就用它那种带有半透明同心外环样式的指示点。在正文区如果需要列举模型启用的特定参数模块或者环境依赖，列表项的前缀直接用它那个自定义的细线蓝色勾选图标就行。在动态响应层面，核心走势图鼠标悬停在特定数据点上时，必须立刻弹出一个带有悬浮阴影的黑色小方块，精准显示两组实验当时的具体损失值、学习率和迭代次数。单列的长文本块里不可避免会穿插许多展示配置环境的代码片段，这些代码块需要支持语法高亮，并且带有一键复制功能，当鼠标移入代码区域时给一个淡淡的灰色背景反馈。文本块的中段我们还会嵌入一张展示各算子耗时与显存占用的长表格，这个表格必须要支持按列大小排序，最重要的是当研究员向下滚动查看长表数据时，表头必须能吸顶固定在屏幕上方，不能跟着滚走。

by_label.A: 极致简化的单列居中布局，顶部仅放搜索框，内容区由一张占满内容宽度的首图和下方等宽的单列文本块构成。

layout.why: 第 1 份是独特的极简搜+图+文单列布局，与其他三份的文档流、多列栅格或不对称双列明显不同。

by_label.A: 纯白背景搭配黑色文本，页面除了列表项前微小的红色圆点外，无其他主色或强调色。
by_label.B: 极致的黑白灰文档配色，纯白底黑字，无任何彩色点缀。
by_label.C: 以浅绿色和淡灰色为主色调（导航高亮、按钮底色），搭配顶部大图的深色半透明遮罩层，整体明亮。
by_label.D: 深色顶栏与浅色内容区对比，高频使用亮蓝色作为强调色（Logo图标、按钮、勾选图标）。

palette.why: 第 3 份独特的浅绿/灰搭配以及深色遮罩的组合，与全黑白、亮蓝点缀的其它份颜色倾向完全不同。

by_label.A: 全局使用较小字号的常规无衬线字体，行距较大，文本层级反差极弱。
by_label.B: 全局使用经典的衬线字体（Serif），带有强烈的传统印刷排印质感，标题与正文字重区分克制，有小型大写字母运用。
by_label.C: 极具力量感的无衬线排版，大量使用全大写字母（ALL CAPS）和极粗字重于各级标题与按钮中。
by_label.D: 常规无衬线字体，通过不同的字号与字重（较粗的小标题搭配常规正文）构建清晰的现代网页信息层级。

typography.why: 第 2 份是四份中唯一通篇采用衬线字体呈现经典学术文档气质的，字族气质极其鲜明。

by_label.A: 几乎无典型UI组件，仅顶部有一个带极细浅色描边的直角单行文本输入框。
by_label.B: 完全无按钮、卡片等控件，数据表格仅靠极简的上下细横线进行分割，无纵向边框。
by_label.C: 按钮表现为无圆角、无阴影的大块面浅色实心矩形，底部社交媒体图标为带轻微圆角的浅灰正方形块。
by_label.D: 包含亮蓝色的直角/微圆角实心扁平按钮，带有半透明同心外环样式的轮播图指示点，以及自定义的细线蓝色勾选列表图标。

component.why: 第 4 份拥有专属的轮播指示器和勾选小图标，其按钮虽然与第 3 份同为直角扁平风，但在具体细节（图标搭配、色彩辨识）上仍可明确区分。

user_prompt_zh: 我们需要一个语义化且断点清晰的数据库慢查询监控面板。整体诉求是搭建一个包含导航和筛选表单的清晰界面，点开具体的慢SQL时能像看大图一样弹窗查看完整的执行计划。空间排布上我希望参考那个大量留白配浅灰文字的网页，采用居中单列或经典的左右对半分排版，区块间距拉大，透出一点手作质朴的极简感。文字细节按那个带各种表单框的界面来做，整体字号偏小，层级对比弱，主要靠深灰和浅灰色来区分表单标签和占位符。页面颜色千万别搞成有绿圈头像和食物图那个页面的样子，那种高饱和亮翠绿色太刺眼了，我就要最普通的低饱和暗色，夜间看监控不伤眼就行。最后是个死要求，里面所有的按钮我要那种两头全圆的药丸形。

user_prompt_en:
I run a small parenting consultancy and we are putting together an interactive digital guide for new parents. I need this to look incredibly professional so families trust our expertise immediately, and it is absolutely crucial that they can spot our phone number and office address the second they load the site. We are aiming for a slightly futuristic, high-tech feel to show our methods are backed by the latest science. Right off the bat, I want the whole page on a dark ground with light text on it. We need a live header that updates a greeting based on the time of day, a main feed for our dynamic feeding and sleep schedules, an interactive tracker for baby milestones where parents can check things off, and a slide-out shopping cart loaded with some dummy data for our recommended gear and formula.

When you build this out, I want the text to look exactly like it does on that page with the thick black wireframes and grids. Use that tight, print-style sans-serif, go heavy on the bold all-caps for all our section titles, and keep the paragraph text sizing pretty close to the headers so the whole thing feels dense and serious. For the actual tracker bits, buttons, and the cart items, look at that dashboard page with the blue map. Make our little interactive cards look just like those flat white data panels packed tightly together. Give them those same barely rounded corners, no shadows at all, and use those little colored background tags inside them to mark if a baby milestone is pending or done. Finally, I definitely do not want the page chopped up like that site with the big light purple blocks with its weird lopsided columns, nor do I want that typical zigzag pattern of alternating images and text from the page with the dark hero picture. Instead, I just want a straightforward, single-column central feed that tired parents can scroll straight down on their phones with one hand.

by_label.A: 顶部大留白单栏标题区连接全宽大色块，下方主体内容采用左宽（正文段落）右窄（总结信息面板）的不对称两栏结构。
by_label.B: 顶部为全宽深色背景巨幕头图，主体内容向下延伸为等宽的图文交替两栏排版（左图右文接右图左文的Z型视线流）。
by_label.C: 全屏应用框架布局，左侧为固定的垂直深色导航栏，右侧大片区域为自适应的多行多列卡片网格。
by_label.D: 严密的复古网格排版系统，依靠纵横交错的粗黑实线将页面切割成大小各异的矩形分栏区块。

layout.why: 被点名的第 1 份（主副栏不对称排版）和第 2 份（等宽图文交替排版）虽然都是较常见的网页布局，但它们的结构特征明确且相互之间有显著差异，拿着成品能说清有没有违规避开这两者。

user_prompt_en:
Here are the core requirements for the new Salt & Stone Q&A community page, focusing on delivering a high-value reading experience for our overseas user base with some complex stateful interactions.
- Structure the content using the blocking strategy from that Chinese explainer page with the green and brown sections, meaning bold structural blocks, a vertical timeline-style feed for the long-form answers, a horizontal row of circles above it for trending topics, and a dedicated narrow sidebar on the right for thread stats.
- Set the palette to match the white checkout form—pure white background, thin light-grey strokes for separation, and a sharp dark red for primary actions like the 'Post Answer' button.
- I want the whole interface to channel the exact mood of that same checkout page, giving off a clinical, hardcore, and highly competitive energy rather than a casual chatroom vibe.
- When upvoting a lengthy response, implement a fluid stateful transition that organically slides down to reveal nested debates while updating a live SVG sentiment visualization right beside the text block.
- Keep the typography highly readable for dense paragraphs; absolutely avoid both the fancy elegant serifs from that church photo page and the massive shouting all-caps text from the dark gym site, opting instead for a pristine, functional sans-serif system.
- For all interactive elements like input fields and vote toggles, ignore the completely bare black-wireframe boxes seen on the first sparse minimalist page; ensure ours have proper tactile affordance, soft hover states, and clear selected indicators to meet basic usability acceptance criteria.

by_label.B: 使用醒目的深色大色块拼接划分区域，带有纵向时间线列表，以及水平排列的圆圈阵列流程，右侧有独立的信息细栏。
by_label.C: 顶部全宽背景大图，下方主内容区采用单列居中及标准的两列网格（图文对排、手风琴折叠面板）。
by_label.D: 左侧为固定的深色垂直导航边栏，右侧为主内容区，包含通栏大图背景和网格卡片排列。
by_label.E: 经典的主次双栏布局，左侧为较宽的表单填写区，右侧为带背景底色的较窄订单摘要边栏。

layout.why: 第 2 份（B）独有的深色块错落拼接及带圆圈的步骤排版，与其余的极简、侧边栏或双栏布局显著不同，一眼即可辨认。

by_label.A: 大面积米黄色底色，文字纯黑，包含默认的蓝色链接。
by_label.B: 米黄色底色，搭配大面积的深棕色、深绿色矩形色块，辅助色为土黄和浅灰。
by_label.C: 浅米白色底色，文字为黑/灰，强调整体沉稳感，唯一的强调色为深墨绿色（按钮和进度条）。
by_label.D: 深灰色至纯黑色的暗调背景，搭配高纯度的鲜橙色作为主要高亮色及按钮颜色。
by_label.E: 纯白底色（右侧有极浅灰微小反差），浅灰色细线描边，强调色为深红色/暗红色（主操作按钮）。

palette.why: 第 5 份（E）纯白背景结合暗红色按钮的配色方案，明显区别于前三份的米黄底色及第四份的纯黑底色，非常独立。

by_label.A: 使用常规大小的无衬线字体，字号几乎无反差，层级感极弱，带下划线的蓝色链接保留原始感。
by_label.B: 以无衬线中文字体为主，利用加粗加大的年份数字作为明确的视觉焦点，字号反差适中。
by_label.C: 大标题使用了醒目的古典衬线字体（Serif），带有优雅气质；正文及次级信息则搭配常规无衬线字体。
by_label.D: 主标题使用了极粗的无衬线全大写字母，字号巨大，极具视觉冲击力和力量感。
by_label.E: 现代标准的无衬线字体，字重使用克制规范（如表单标签微粗，正文常规），层级分明不夸张。

typography.why: 第 3 份（C）的古典衬线大标题与第 4 份（D）的超粗全大写无衬线大标题风格迥异，两者均有极其强烈的特征，极易识别。

by_label.A: 没有任何常规样式的按钮，交互组件仅表现为黑细线直角方框（无填充、无圆角、无阴影）。
by_label.B: 无传统按钮，信息载体多为无描边的纯色直角大色块，或是由细线组成的圆圈环绕文字。
by_label.C: 按钮为全圆角（药丸状）且使用深色纯色填充，无边框和阴影；输入框为浅色微圆角。
by_label.D: 按钮为小圆角矩形配合高饱和度纯色填充，卡片组件为纯色暗色大圆角且无边框阴影。
by_label.E: 标准的现代表单组件，输入框带有明显的浅灰色细描边和微小圆角，主按钮为小圆角实心填充。

component.why: 第 1 份（A）如同未加载CSS般的细黑线直角框风格极其特殊、罕见，作为反面要求极易判别。

ref_checklist_seeds.avoid_desc: 大标题使用了醒目的古典衬线字体（Serif），带有优雅气质；正文及次级信息则搭配常规无衬线字体。
ref_checklist_seeds.question_zh: 字体排版（字族气质、字号层级、行距、字重对比）是否明显不同于「教堂建筑大图页」那一份（大标题使用了醒目的古典衬线字体（Serif），带有优雅气质；正文及次级信息则搭配常规无衬线字体。）？跟成了即为不通过。

ref_checklist_seeds.avoid_desc: 主标题使用了极粗的无衬线全大写字母，字号巨大，极具视觉冲击力和力量感。

ref_checklist_seeds.avoid_desc: 没有任何常规样式的按钮，交互组件仅表现为黑细线直角方框（无填充、无圆角、无阴影）。
ref_checklist_seeds.question_zh: 组件样式（卡片/按钮/输入框、圆角、阴影、描边）是否明显不同于「极简浅色小图页」那一份（没有任何常规样式的按钮，交互组件仅表现为黑细线直角方框（无填充、无圆角、无阴影）。）？跟成了即为不通过。

user_prompt_zh:
**概述**
作为平时经常码字发文的人，这次我想给自己和读者搭一个「本地活动日历」网站，主要用来汇集咱们同城平时大大小小的聚会和互助工具。受众大部分是每天刷手机的重度移动端用户，所以感觉上一定要温暖亲和，像是一个大家经常串门的线上客厅。交付上有一个死要求：页面的语义标签一定要写好，务必要能被搜索引擎轻松抓到。

**页面结构**
我想把整个站设计成几个清晰的板块，不用太复杂但得全：
1. 顶部引言：一句简短的欢迎语，带出咱们社区的温度。
2. 近期活动看板：按照时间线把将要举办的线下局列出来。
3. 往期归档：专门留一块地方给我写活动回顾，阅读体验必须要好。
4. 提报表单：让大家能自己提交想办的活动，包含基础的输入框和提交功能。
关于大框架，有一点我已经定死了：在屏幕够宽的桌面端，内容区我要左右两栏并排着看，比如左侧刷日历，右侧看长篇的图文归档。

**视觉**
虽然是个偏生活化的小站，但我这次想尝试点特别的颜色。你看后面那套画着好多彩色节点连线的深色网页，它的底色我就特别喜欢。背景和 UI 面板就用它那种深空蓝和极暗灰色，这种深色暗夜基调看着特别沉浸。日历里各种活动分类的标签，可以拿它图里那些节点用的高饱和红、绿、黄、紫等色彩来点缀，对比会很生动。

至于字怎么排、具体的块面怎么画，开头那几个浅色白底落地页截图里的做法就非常合适。字的话就用常规的无衬线字体，标题字号要大且字重高，正文字号保持常规、并且多采用居中对齐，整个阅读层级拉得特别清晰，这对我的读者很重要。里面的小元素也看它的做法，我要那种带一点微圆角的实心亮蓝色按钮；其他信息卡片或者图文占位的地方，直接用大面积平涂的矩形直角或是纯圆形色块就行，不要任何明显的描边，干干净净就好。

**交互**
移动端优先，所以响应式必须要丝滑，左右两栏在手机上自动折叠成上下单列。表单输入体验要对触屏友好，点击输入框不能乱放大。日历里的分类标签点击后最好能快速筛选。

**验收**
1. 单文件交付，代码结构严谨，H1-H6 和 article 等标签使用标准。
2. 移动端首屏加载不出现横向滚动条，各板块文字不断行错乱。
3. 所有的按钮和表单元素在触屏设备上均达到易点击标准。

user_prompt_en:
**Overview**
The objective here is to build the definitive "About Us" experience for Two Rivers. We are an environmental strategy and landscape restoration consultancy, and our digital presence needs to immediately communicate scale, natural grounding, and operational excellence. This single-page build shouldn't feel like a standard corporate brochure. I want it to read like an immersive narrative combined with a live view of our impact. It needs to tell the story of who we are, where we operate, and the people driving the mission, culminating in a robust contact funnel for prospective partners.

**Page structure**
The architecture of the page needs to feel expansive and data-rich. We are going to step away from traditional stacked horizontal bands for the hero section.

*   **Top Navigation:** A clean, sticky navigation bar holding our "Two Rivers" logo on the far left, with links for "Mission", "Impact", "Leadership", and "Connect" aligned to the right.
*   **Hero & Impact Core:** This is where we anchor the experience. I want this blocked out similarly to the deep blue page with the world map. Give the left or center of the screen a massive, dominant focal area—in our case, an interactive data visualization or globe representing our active restoration zones—and have our key mission statements and data points living in floating side panels or centered overlays right on top of it. 
*   **Impact Metrics:** Inside those floating panels, we need hard numbers to establish authority. Include three primary data lockups: "1.2M Hectares Restored", "14 Active Global Watersheds", and "$40M+ Directed to Ground-Level Conservation".
*   **The Origin Narrative:** Below the main impact area, a dedicated text-driven section detailing our history. Include this specific copy: "Founded by Dr. Aris Thorne and Elena Rostova, Two Rivers began with a radical premise for 2015: that ecological restoration could outpace industrial degradation if mapped correctly. From a two-person desk in Portland to a global network of earth-scientists, our mission remains unchanged. Water shapes the earth, and we must learn to shape our systems around the water."
*   **Leadership Grid:** A robust section introducing our four managing partners. This needs photo placeholders, names, titles, and a short bio for each. 
    *   Dr. Aris Thorne - Chief Ecologist. "Aris brings 20 years of watershed management experience to the forefront of our operations."
    *   Elena Rostova - Head of Global Strategy. "Focusing on sustainable deployment and international government relations."
    *   Marcus Vance - Lead Cartographer. "Turning raw climate data into actionable, predictive terrain models."
    *   Dr. Linnea Sterling - Community Liaison. "Bridging the critical gap between our ecological science and local human populations."
*   **Connect Form:** A comprehensive footer-level section containing a contact form. We need fields for Full Name, Organization, a dropdown for "Inquiry Type" (Partnership, Press, Careers), and a multiline message area, alongside our physical address in Seattle.

**Visual**
The brand tone is organic but highly professional—we are scientists and strategists, not just activists.

*   **Backgrounds & Accents:** For the colors, I want to use the exact treatment from that site with the slider cards. Flood the background with that sweeping gradient that starts as a deep forest green and transitions down into a brownish-yellow, and use that sharp, bright yellow as the primary accent for things like our call-to-action buttons and active states.
*   **Fonts & Reading Experience:** Our text needs to feel academic yet accessible. I was looking at that black page with the dark cards, and the way the headings there are incredibly thick, massive, and all-caps right next to tiny body text is way too aggressive for our brand. I do not want that kind of extreme contrast. Keep our headings grounded—use a distinguished, medium-weight serif that flows naturally into highly legible, standard-sized body text. We want it to feel like reading a high-end scientific journal, not being yelled at by a billboard.
*   **Containers & Surfaces:** When it comes to housing our content (like the leadership bios or the impact data), they need to feel like distinct, physical objects. I noticed the beige retro-looking document page just uses those ultra-thin, right-angle single lines to separate things without any background fills. I really dislike that approach; keep it far away from this build. Instead, ensure our floating panels and form containers have actual substance. Give them semi-transparent background fills, slightly rounded corners, and a soft elevation shadow so they visually lift off the green-yellow gradient background.

**Interaction**
*   The sticky top navigation must transition from transparent at the very top of the page to a solid dark green once the user scrolls past the hero section.
*   The floating panels over the hero area should have a very subtle, continuous vertical float animation to make the command center feel "alive."
*   Form inputs need distinct focus states—the bottom border should illuminate in our bright yellow accent color when a user is actively typing.
*   Buttons should scale up slightly (approximately 1.05x) and increase their drop shadow on hover to invite the click.

**Acceptance**
*   The single-file HTML delivery must be fully responsive, gracefully collapsing the complex hero and floating panel structure into a vertically stacked sequence on viewport widths under 768px.
*   The background must be implemented purely via CSS gradients, with no image assets required for the global page backdrop.
*   All interactive elements (navigation links, form fields, submit buttons) must meet minimum touch target sizes of 44x44 pixels for mobile usability.
*   The page structure must remain unbroken and highly legible across 1440px, 1024px, and 375px viewport widths.
*   Submitting the form should trigger a localized visual success state (e.g., swapping the button text to "Message Received" and turning the button solid green) without attempting to reload the page or navigate away.

by_label.B: 常规的左文右图（或导航）、多列网格卡片排列以及底部并排的表单与信息栏布局。
by_label.C: 典型的工具型操作台布局，以左侧或居中的巨大地图区域为核心，配合右侧悬浮说明面板或居中遮罩弹窗。
by_label.D: 顶部居中大标题配合横向贯穿屏幕的数据统计条，下方紧接支持横向滑动的卡片轮播区。

layout.why: 第3份（图7-9）是明显的工具操作台结构（大块地图+浮动面板），其余三份都是上下滚动的文档流或展示流结构，完全不同。

by_label.A: 整体为极低饱和度的浅米色/奶黄色底，配合深灰色文字与金棕色细线条。
by_label.B: 纯黑底色为主，点缀带有蓝色和紫色渐变的高亮色（按钮和环境光晕）。
by_label.C: 深蓝色页面底色，主体面板为灰白色，地图上有多彩的高饱和色块（橙、绿、紫）。
by_label.D: 大面积从深绿色过渡到偏黄褐色的全局渐变底色，强调色为明黄色。

palette.why: 第4份（图10-12）极其鲜明的全局深绿到黄色的渐变背景，与其他三份的米色、纯黑、深蓝底色形成强烈反差，一眼可辨。

by_label.A: 通篇使用优雅复古的衬线字体，标题与正文字号差距适中，排版充满纸质书刊感。
by_label.B: 标题采用了字重极粗、字号极大的无衬线字体，且多为全大写，与较小的正文形成极其强烈的对比。
by_label.C: 常规的现代无衬线字体，字号层级清晰中规中矩，无极端对比。
by_label.D: 现代无衬线体，标题字体偏大且有左对齐和居中对齐的混合，数字字体粗大醒目。

typography.why: 第2份（图4-6）中类似“TURNING THE ORDINARY...”这种占据大半屏幕、字重极粗且全大写的重磅无衬线标题，特征太过抢眼，很容易判断是否被模仿。

by_label.A: 几乎没有传统的“面”状组件，不用背景色块、圆角和阴影，仅用极细的直角单线框来充当卡片或边界。

user_prompt_zh:
本次需求是开发「黑石 900」大师联名款手办的全球首发落地页，核心目标是通过极强的前卫视觉拉满发售期待感，确保阅读体验和预约转化率，以下是具体执行要求：
- 页面骨架看那个展示服装商品的页面，顶上居中放品牌标识和横向导航，下面主体直接铺经典的三列等宽商品图片网格，这种阵列对展示我们的盲盒异色版最有效，每一列放一个款式的多角度视图。
- 颜色直接抓最后那套有窑炉数据面板里的，用极深的黑灰色做大底色，然后大面积用它那种高饱和度的黄绿色来做强调，首屏的倒计时文字、库存图表和高亮标签都用这个黄绿，视觉冲击力要顶满。
- 这次产品背景故事里有大量长篇幅的设定和工艺正文，优先保证阅读体验和基本无障碍（键盘要能完整操作，对比度要达标），所以千万别搞成那个讲留声机原理页面那样的，全篇用古典衬线字、标题还居中且一堆斜体，大段看太累了；我们就用现代感强、字重清晰的无衬线体，字距稍微拉开点。
- 预约填写的表单、参数卡片还有最下面的购买按钮，质感要精细锋利，别学第一套带地址的联系表单里那种浅灰色微圆角底框和药丸形状的实色按钮，太常规了；也绝对别像那个米黄色植物表格调查页一样，全是用生硬的大粗黑实线去死磕边框和表格分割，像老纸质报表；我们要用悬浮感的极细边框，配合一点内发光效果。
- 核心首屏安排一个实时数据图表，展示目前全球各时区的预约热度分布，进入页面时图表要有动态生长和柱状图弹出的连贯加载动画。
- 三列网格里的模型卡片要有复杂的交互切换，默认展示黑白线框草图，鼠标悬停时平滑渐变到带有光影追迹的彩色3D渲染图，并浮现具体的三围比例。
- 滚动监听要做足，长篇设定文字进入视口时，文字段落要带有逐行显现的渐入效果，背景配合微弱的视差滚动，不能干巴巴地直接展示。
- 移动端适配标准不能降，三列网格在手机端必须平滑折叠为单列瀑布流，且顶部导航收缩为全屏带阻尼感的汉堡菜单。
- 验收红线：所有可交互元素必须有明显的获取焦点轮廓，表单错误提示不能仅用颜色区分，必须配套震动反馈和清晰的文案。
- 尾部留一个大尺寸的抽签订阅区，只收邮箱，提交成功后用代码流转的动画替换输入框，直接给用户生成动态的专属排队编号。

by_label.A: 顶部左对齐导航，主体内容为非对称的两列布局，左侧较宽为表单，右侧为堆叠的信息块。
by_label.B: 居中的单列流式布局，类似传统文档，两侧留有大量空白。
by_label.C: 顶部横向导航条，主体分为带左侧边栏的多列说明区和下方占据全宽的单列表格区。
by_label.D: 顶部居中品牌标志及横向导航，主体采用经典的三列等宽商品图片网格布局。
by_label.E: 满宽顶栏，主体内容由多列紧凑的数据指标区、横向分布的进度条以及下方的图文混排区组成。

layout.why: 第 4 份（D）是典型的画廊/商品网格布局（多列等比卡片阵列），与其他所有的文本流、两列分栏或仪表盘布局截然不同，极易区分。

by_label.A: 纯白背景搭配极浅灰色内容区，主色和强调色为深沉的藏青/深蓝色。
by_label.B: 最基础的白底黑字，辅以浅灰色的注释或引用文字，无彩色倾向。
by_label.C: 通体采用米黄色/浅复古纸张底色，文字和边框线均为纯黑色。
by_label.D: 白色大背景，商品卡片带有中性浅灰底色，整体极度克制，视觉色彩完全交由商品图片本身。
by_label.E: 深色模式，以极深的黑灰色为背景，大面积使用高饱和度的黄绿色作为强调色（文字、图表、进度条）。

palette.why: 第 5 份（E）是这五份中唯一一个纯正的深色主题（黑底），且配合了极具视觉冲击力的亮绿色，闭着眼也能跟其他浅色/米色页面分清。

by_label.A: 现代无衬线字体，字号对比极其夸张（首屏包含巨大的粗体大标题），信息层级分明。
by_label.B: 通篇采用古典的衬线字体，标题居中，正文行距宽松，包含较多斜体排版，呈现出典型的传统印刷书籍质感。
by_label.C: 基础的中文字体排版，字重变化较少，整体字号偏小，主要为了在表格中高密度展示信息。
by_label.D: 以纤细干净的无衬线体为主，除 Logo 外无明显大标题，整体轻盈，价格和名称字号相近。
by_label.E: 无衬线字体，广泛使用大写字母，数字指标字号明显放大且字重较轻，呈现出清晰的仪表盘数据感。

typography.why: 被点名的第 2 份（B）全盘使用了衬线字体和典型的书籍文献式排版，这在其它几份全无衬线、偏现代化 UI 的页面中是一个非常强烈的特征。

by_label.A: 包含带浅灰色微圆角底框的信息卡片、带有细边框的圆角输入框，以及具有强烈全圆角（药丸状）特征的实色按钮。
by_label.B: 几乎没有常规 Web UI 组件，仅通过字体样式、缩进和极细的浅灰色分割线来组织内容。
by_label.C: 没有任何圆角或卡片概念，大量采用硬朗的粗黑实线作为边框和表格分割，风格类似老式的纸质报表。
by_label.D: 无边框的图片展示块，悬浮交互时会出现深色半透明遮罩，并包含带有直角白底的微型功能图标（放大镜、心形等）。
by_label.E: 没有传统的填充型按钮或卡片，组件以极细的暗色线条分割框、线条构成的进度条和几何线框图示为主。

component.why: 被点名的两份中，A 拥有典型的现代大圆角按钮和输入框，C 则是完全复古硬朗的直角黑线表格，两者不仅都有极强的特征，且风格截然对立，完全能作为反面判分标准。

user_prompt_en: I write long-form opinion columns and need a home for my new series. It should feature a stateful archive with dynamic sorting, but it has to load incredibly fast with zero code bloat. For the reading experience, I want the text to perfectly match that plain white document near the end—using traditional serifs, sharp size contrasts, and clean indents to build a serious, academic weight. I definitely don't want the awkward asymmetrical three-column structure from that pink love letter page; I just want a centered, distraction-free reading well. For the interactive bits like filter menus and subscribe inputs, borrow the style from the landing page with the staggered white cards: use those crisp edges, barely-there shadows, and green-yellow gradient buttons. Finally, please avoid the stark palettes of both the bright blue software site and the neon glow of the dark service page. I'd much prefer a calming, warm paper-toned background that is easy on the eyes.

user_prompt_en:
I am working on my final project for my web development course, and I need to build a comprehensive website for a fictional K-12 progressive school called Starlight Academy. I was wondering if we could make it quite ambitious, going beyond a simple static brochure to include some complex interactions and stateful views to really impress my professor and help me learn advanced techniques. The first thing to note, which is a hard requirement I have already decided on for the overall reading experience, is that the body text must be at 18px or larger. Anything smaller my mother cannot read, and I want to make sure the site is comfortable for parents to browse.

As for how the content is organized, I know exactly what I want to avoid. I really do not want it to look like that retro text-heavy page with the thick black borders, which relies on a dense, newspaper-like multi-column grid with a wide text block on the left and a narrow timeline on the right. I also definitely do not want the pure, flat structure of that clothing shop page with its rigid, uninterrupted three-column grid of perfectly equal square pictures and no sidebars. Instead, I want a much more fluid, narrative-driven layout where the sections breathe. We can start with a dynamic hero section that introduces the school's core philosophy. Below that, I would love an interactive data visualization section showing our student demographics, graduation rates, and the number of extracurricular clubs. Maybe these could be animated counters or a dynamic chart that draws itself as you scroll into view. After that, we need a stateful curriculum section where parents can click through different tabs to seamlessly swap the content between the Elementary, Middle, and High School programs without the page having to reload.

To make the school stand out from traditional, boring educational institutions, I want to capture a very specific atmosphere. It should feel exactly like that dark interactive page with the scattered little animals. I want the whole site to give off that dreamy, lively night-time amusement park vibe, full of childlike wonder and a completely informal, relaxed, and slightly mysterious energy. To achieve this, I want to use the exact colours from that same starry animal page. Could we use that deep purple and blue starry night background for the entire site, and then use those highly saturated, bright neon pinks and light purples as the glowing emphasis colours for our important text and active states? I think that would look incredibly unique for a modern academy.

Even though the background will be dark and playful, the functional parts of the site still need to look clean and usable, especially the admissions application form at the bottom. For these elements, I want to borrow the visual treatment from that landing page that has the large blue ocean background. Let us use its input fields and buttons. Specifically, I love the pure white, long rectangular text inputs with their very faint, light grey drop shadows, the solid bright blue buttons with their slight rounded corners, and the thin-line dark blue icons for the feature list. I think placing those crisp, modern cards and form fields against our dark, dreamy background will create a fantastic contrast. Could we stitch all these ideas together into a single, fully functional HTML file so I can study the code and understand exactly how you implemented the tabs and the animations?

user_prompt_en:
**Overview**
The current development sprint focuses on delivering the core reading interface for Third Shelf, our new webcomic platform tailored for primary schoolers. The primary objective is to build an immersive, distraction-free environment that accommodates dynamic story flows while keeping navigation intuitive for younger users. We are aiming for a highly stateful view that tracks reading progress in real-time and handles transitions seamlessly between library browsing and active reading.

**Page structure**
The interface will feature a hidden top-level navigation, the primary comic display zone, a collapsible chapter index, and a persistent progress footer. For the main display zone, lay it out exactly like the full-screen setup in the second set of shots: a completely borderless, edge-to-edge spread divided into a strict four-column grid with absolutely zero gaps between the image modules. This grid must flow straight down and terminate directly into a solid, dark horizontal footer bar at the very bottom.

**Visual**
I want the whole page on a dark ground with light text on it. This will help with eye fatigue during longer reading sessions. For the text elements, look at the approach from that pale, heavily spaced document page. Give the wording a vintage serif feel where the visual hierarchy is kept very flat and the stroke weight remains uniform across different labels. Critically, utilize top-to-bottom vertical text runs for the main comic titles and the sidebar chapter items to create a classic storybook atmosphere.

For the actual controls—like the zoom toggles or menu triggers—we are not using enclosed boxes or solid background cards. Instead, handle the UI regions exactly like the first, news-style page does: frame the functional areas using distinctive pale grey curly braces ({), or use extremely minimal, borderless icons, similar to that bare little round button floating in its top right corner.

**Interaction**
The view must handle complex state transitions. Tapping an individual panel within the grid triggers a smooth cinematic expansion, scaling the image to the viewport height and hiding the surrounding grid. While in this active reading state, the user's scroll wheel or swipe gestures will snap focus to the next panel in the array rather than allowing free scrolling. The bottom bar must actively sync with this state to update the reading completion percentage.

**Acceptance**
- The four-column grid displays seamlessly with zero margins or gutters at 1280px.
- Vertical text runs remain legible and correctly aligned without clipping on tablet displays.
- Interactive touch targets for the borderless icons are artificially padded to a minimum of 44x44px to accommodate children's motor skills.
- The dark background and light text combination strictly meets WCAG AAA contrast standards.
- State changes between the global grid view and focused panel mode complete within 300ms without layout thrashing.

by_label.A: 居中对齐的单页布局，顶部有简明的水平导航，内容区呈现非对称的双栏结构（左侧窄栏放元数据/导航，右侧宽栏放主正文），留白较多。
by_label.B: 全屏无边界铺满的均等四列图片网格布局，各个模块之间完全没有间隙，底部紧接一个深色的水平底栏。
by_label.C: 模仿传统纸张的非对称松散布局，页面四周和大块内容之间存在极大的留白空间，并在右上角等位置布置了孤立的垂直排列信息区。

layout.why: 第 2 份是全屏无间距的均等图片网格，这与第 1 份居中图文和第 3 份极其松散的大留白布局有着结构性的根本差异（见图5）。

by_label.A: 标题采用字号极大、字重较大的粗体衬线字，而正文段落则使用常规无衬线字，形成强烈的粗细与字体种类对比。
by_label.B: 主要文字作为图片的附属元素，采用全大写、细字重、宽字间距的小号无衬线体，整体存在感较弱。
by_label.C: 全篇使用具有复古气质的中文字体（类似宋体），视觉层级平缓且字重统一，最突出的特征是大量使用从上到下的竖向文字排版（如主标题和侧边栏项目）。

typography.why: 第 3 份全局采用复古中文衬线体且存在明显的垂直竖排文字设计，这种传统排版风格在另外两份完全现代的横排西文版式中找不到任何相似点（见图9）。

by_label.A: 几乎不使用带底色或完整边框的卡片，主要通过极具特色的浅灰色大括号符号（{）或极其极简的图标（如右上角无边框小圆钮）来框定和提示局部功能区。
by_label.B: 完全由纯粹的直角矩形图片本身充当信息承载单元，没有额外添加任何表单、按钮或修饰性边框。
by_label.C: 通过极细的红色彩色短横线来分隔列表条目，少量标签仅使用红色的极简方形线框包裹，无任何阴影或圆角背景填充。

component.why: 第 1 份在侧边栏使用浅色大括号来聚拢链接这一做法（如图2左侧）是非常独特的组件层特征，足以区别于第 2 份的纯图块和第 3 份的极细红线。

作为协会主导这次体验改版的交互设计师，我梳理了今年的年度报告页核心诉求。我们这个关注民间手工艺的行业协会本身带着些手作质朴的基因，所以在构筑这份数字报告时，我希望能用严谨但不冰冷的设计语言来呈现。我们先定一下页面的文字骨架，那个开头是一张大宇航员照片的长文章页面里的文字设定我觉得特别有味道，主干部分可以大面积铺设宽行距的经典衬线体来烘托沉浸式的阅读感，而各个板块的标题则压实字重用无衬线体撑住整个版面层级，这种类似传统纸质杂志的层级拉扯，恰好能压得住年度报告的庄重感。

至于版式的叙事节奏，我希望去贴合那个第一屏是纯蓝底色配个手机外壳图的展示页，头屏做左右两列的开局，左边放我们今年的主题“经纬”，右边做个简单的互动引语。当视线往下游走进入正文段落时，结构切成居中的宽幅区块，然后交替使用图文上下堆叠和左右对齐并排的形式往下延伸，这样长页面的空间感就不会单调。顺带着，颜色的定调也完全听从这个蓝首屏页面的指引，头屏铺展那种大面积的纯蓝色作为视觉锚点，往下滚动时底部的容器背景就在纯白和浅灰之间来回切换以此做内容分段，所有的可点击控件、按钮焦点提炼成深蓝色，而正文字段控制在中度灰色，整体保持极高的视觉信噪比。

进入到核心的行业数据概览和年度项目验收板块时，页面需要承载庞大的数据图表和状态切换。这里的微观细节我非常看好最后面那个全是监控仪表的后台管理页，也就是里面那些没有任何生硬刻意感、仅靠极微弱阴影托底的纯白色数据卡片。我们要把这些卡片作为承载年度成员增长数据的容器，里面植入高对比色彩的柱状图和面积图来做数据可视化。在这个区块我设计了一些复杂的微交互，当用户的指针滑过代表各个地方分会的柱状图时，对应的白色卡片需要顺滑翻转，展现背后的明细列表表格。在项目验收状态部分，我也想拿那个仪表盘页面里的带圆角的状态复选框来做文章，做一个可筛选的动态列表，勾选不同的手艺复兴项目状态，底部的网格内容会带有平滑的位移过渡进行实时重新排列。最后是我们的联合发声板块，这里会有一封超长的会长致辞，刚好能把前面说的杂志感文字运用到极致。致辞旁边我们要配一个可以拖拽的时间轴，拖动时旁边的数据卡片参数会随年份动态插值滚动。整个页面的视差滚动和转场需要像匠人打磨器物一样，去掉所有弹跳和夸张的缓冲，保留那种克制、流畅且贴手的线性阻尼感，让用户在这个充满理性数据可视化的蓝色体系里，依然能通过微小的反馈感受到属于手工艺人的那份温润。

by_label.A: 首屏为全宽大图，下方是通栏的单列纯文本流式布局，信息密度低。
by_label.B: 首屏左右两列，主体内容采用居中的宽幅区块，交替使用上下堆叠和左右图文并排结构。
by_label.C: 左侧常驻导航侧边栏，右侧主区域为密集的网格布局，由多行多列尺寸不一的区块拼装而成。

layout.why: 第 2 份（B）特有的首屏分列以及下方的图文模块交错居中排版，与 A 的通篇单列文本和 C 的复杂密集栅格截然不同（对比图1、5、9）。

by_label.A: 除了首屏深色大图，整体呈极简黑白灰风格，白底黑字，无明显的彩色装饰元素。
by_label.B: 首屏采用大面积纯蓝背景底色，下方页面以白底和浅灰底交替，交互组件使用深蓝色，文字偏中度灰色。
by_label.C: 浅色后台经典配色，浅灰大背景上放置纯白卡片，信息与图表大量使用亮蓝色和显眼的橘黄色作为视觉高亮。

palette.why: 第 2 份（B）拥有非常独特的大面积纯蓝底色首屏（图5），与 A 的无彩色和 C 的多色数据图表（带大块黄/蓝）区分明显；但若仅截取 B 的下方白色区块，可能会削弱其配色特征。

by_label.A: 标题使用无衬线字体，正文则大面积使用经典的衬线体（Serif），字号适中，行距较宽，带有浓厚的传统杂志阅读感。
by_label.B: 全局使用无衬线字体，字号相对统一，正文主要依靠较浅的灰度进行层级区分。
by_label.C: 全局使用紧凑的无衬线界面字体，字号普遍偏小，强调用字重和灰度构建复杂的界面信息层级。

typography.why: 第 1 份（A）的正文使用了极其明显的衬线字体（图2），而另外两份均是从头到尾的无衬线字体，一眼即可认出。

by_label.A: 极少UI组件，主要是原生的文本块和图片穿插。
by_label.B: 组件以展示性为主，包括裁切成正圆形的图片、带圆角的实色/线框大按钮以及浅灰色的线性图标。
by_label.C: 拥有极度丰富的后台表单组件库，满屏全是带有微弱阴影或无边框的白色数据卡片、彩色柱状/面积图表、列表表格和状态复选框。

component.why: 第 3 份（C）充满了高度定制的仪表盘独有组件（数据表、可视化图表，如图9、10），这在展示类页面 A 和 B 中完全找不到对应物。

user_prompt_zh: 我们“慢半拍”课题组一直希望能有个真正属于自己的网上大本营，用来向社区和公众如实交代我们最近在做些什么科研项目。因为是一个预算相对有限的非营利性质研究小组，我们不需要那种酷炫得让人头晕的复杂门面，反而希望它能透出一种手作般质朴实在的气息，让老百姓一看就觉得信息给得很清楚、很真诚。我希望这个主页的整体骨架就照着最前面那套带侧边栏的后台系统来，左边做成固定不变的导航条，包含“研究方向”、“田野日志”和“团队成员”这些，让大家无论翻到哪儿都不会迷路。右边的主区域则按网格排满一块块的矩形内容区，最上面放几项我们的核心指标，比如驻点社区数量、开源数据集和累计调研时长，中间放一幅大的数据图表，底下跟着排布详细的课题产出列表，把原本散落的信息整合得井井有条。往这些网格里填内容的时候，装东西的容器就用前面那个后台系统里带一点淡淡阴影的白色圆角卡片，看起来规整又舒服，如果有需要点击的按钮，也做成那种常规的小圆角实心色块就行。遇到要搜寻往期文献的输入框就留个干净的线框，底下的开源论文名录就用那种最标准的斑马线表格来一行行展示，清清爽爽。另外字我要那种打字机一样每个字一样宽的，感觉敲出来的每一行代码和每一句结论都特别踏实不浮躁。至于画面的颜色，我很喜欢后面那个植物标本长网页里用的那一套，背景大面积铺满那种低饱和度的米黄或者说浅卡其色，然后大标题、正文文字和主要的色块就用它里面的深橄榄绿或者深棕褐色来压住，整体透着一种沉静复古的稳重感，特别契合我们做长线田野调查的耐心。在这个框架里，中间那个图表区域我希望能做个比较复杂的互动展示，比如一个慢生态调研的课题网络拓扑图，当鼠标悬停或者按键盘切换过去的时候，相邻的研究节点会连带高亮并弹出简短的摘要卡片，清楚地向公众展示出各个子项目是怎么互相支撑的。最后，因为我们要考虑到各类社区人群的使用，交付的页面一定要满足基本的无障碍访问要求，除了刚才提到的所有交互节点都必须能用键盘按序抵达，那组深色字和米黄底色的对比度也要保证调到足够高，保障视障或老年访客也能毫不费力地阅读。希望能帮我们把这个踏实的研究家园建起来。

by_label.A: 经典的后台仪表盘结构：左侧固定导航栏，右侧主区域按网格排布成多个矩形模块（顶部数据指标、中部图表、底部列表）。
by_label.B: 单列瀑布流的长页布局，通过全宽的带状色块或横线划分水平区块，区块内部多采用大标题加两栏大段文本的阅读排版。

layout.why: A是高度模块化的管理后台网格布局，B是偏向画册杂志风格的单向阅读流布局，结构差异极其显著。

by_label.A: 白底为主，主色和强调色多为高明度高饱和度的颜色（亮蓝色的按钮/头部区域，鲜艳的绿、黄、紫色用于图表和状态标签）。
by_label.B: 背景大面积使用低饱和度的米黄色/浅卡其色，大标题、文字和主要色块使用深橄榄绿或深棕褐色，整体色调暗沉且复古。

palette.why: A是典型的现代高对比度冷白调加亮色点缀，B是低饱和度暖黄底色加深绿色，两者的底色和主色系完全不同，一眼可辨。

by_label.A: 大量使用带轻微阴影的白色圆角矩形卡片作为内容容器，按钮是常规的小圆角实心色块，带有标准的线框输入框和标准斑马线表格。
by_label.B: 摒弃了包裹式的卡片设计，主要依靠横向细线条分割内容；特色组件是底部排列的、带有极细深色描边的巨大正圆形徽章式按钮。

component.why: A完全遵循现代标准UI组件库样式（阴影圆角卡片），B极简且扁平，没有实体卡片，巨大的细线圆按钮具有强烈的排版特征，不可能混淆。

user_prompt_en:
**Overview**: As a content creator who usually focuses on deep-dive editorial pieces, I am branching out into hosting live corporate summits under my brand, Blue Hour. I need to build a venue seat selection page where enterprise procurement decision-makers can securely book executive boxes and VIP seating blocks for their teams. The experience needs to read as beautifully as one of my essays, but function like a high-end commercial booking tool.

**Page structure**:
* A top header displaying the event title, date, and a live countdown timer.
* An interactive venue map occupying the left two-thirds of the screen.
* A sticky side panel on the right detailing the selected zone's amenities, catering options, and capacity.
* A stateful bottom bar summarizing the chosen seats and running total.
* A text-heavy lower section for booking terms, cancellation policies, and a rich history of the venue space.

**Visual**:
* For the colors, I want to use the palette from that dark page with the three price tiers. Give me that pitch-black background and crisp white text, and heavily saturate the selected seats and primary buttons with that bright neon green, using tiny flashes of orange for warning states.
* The page needs to give off the exact same feeling as that dark one, too—modern, high-impact, and buzzing with a kind of cyberpunk, tech-business tension.
* However, because I care deeply about the reading experience for the venue history and terms, the text treatment needs to come straight from that light, newspaper-like reading page. I want those elegant traditional serifs, extreme size contrasts between the main headers and body copy, a massive drop cap for the opening paragraph, and small caps for the meta-information.
* For the amenity info boxes in the right panel: no shadows on the cards, I dislike that floating look. Keep them strictly flat with sharp borders.

**Interaction**:
* The seating map requires complex SVG panning and zooming so buyers can inspect specific rows closely.
* Hovering over a seating block highlights the SVG path in neon green and triggers a floating tooltip with real-time availability data.
* Clicking a seat instantly adds it to the bottom bar's array, recalculating the grand total and updating the available seat counter without any page reloads.

**Acceptance**:
* Delivered as a single, self-contained HTML file.
* The interactive map performs smoothly and remains responsive on a standard 1080p display.
* The extreme text size hierarchy stays fully legible and doesn't break the container boundaries when the right panel shrinks.

user_prompt_en:
I'm a tech blogger who writes a lot about dev tools, and I need a new API documentation site for my readers, mostly professional developers who need clear, interactive references without losing that deep-reading essay feel I like to maintain.
- The content area must be split into two side-by-side columns, full stop, so I can have the narrative explanations on the left and the interactive code runners right next to them.
- For the colors, I want exactly what is shown on that first set of screenshots with the data blocks—give me that near-black, deep blue background and fill the main interactive blocks with those high-saturation bright blues, purples, and cyans, using that vivid green specifically for successful response texts or active tags.
- I need an interactive request builder that maintains complex state, where users can dynamically toggle headers, add nested JSON parameters, and watch the mock payload update live with smooth CSS transitions.
- A sticky table of contents and a comprehensive archive panel are essential so practitioners can easily jump between different endpoint versions without losing track of their reading progress.
- For how the text looks, check the second batch of images from the light reading page—I want that same airy, generous line spacing for the body paragraphs, and definitely grab the idea of using those widely-spaced, all-caps, small sans-serif fonts for the parameter names and method labels, leaving plenty of breathing room around everything.
